Mask World Model: Predicting What Matters for Robust Robot Policy Learning

简要说明：掩码世界模型通过预测语义掩码的演变，而非像素，专注于机器人策略学习的关键动态，展现出优于基于RGB的方法的鲁棒性。

TLDR: Mask World Model predicts semantic mask evolution instead of pixels, focusing on essential dynamics for robust robot policy learning and outperforms RGB-based methods.

Abstract: World models derived from large-scale video generative pre-training have emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist robot policy learning. However, standard approaches often focus on high-fidelity RGB video prediction, this can result in overfitting to irrelevant factors, such as dynamic backgrounds and illumination changes. These distractions reduce the model's ability to generalize, ultimately leading to unreliable and fragile control policies. To address this, we introduce the Mask World Model (MWM), which leverages video diffusion architectures to predict the evolution of semantic masks instead of pixels. This shift imposes a geometric information bottleneck, forcing the model to capture essential physical dynamics and contact relations while filtering out visual noise. We seamlessly integrate this mask dynamics backbone with a diffusion-based policy head to enable robust end-to-end control. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the superiority of MWM on the LIBERO and RLBench simulation benchmarks, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art RGB-based world models. Furthermore, real-world experiments and robustness evaluation (via random token pruning) reveal that MWM exhibits superior generalization capabilities and robust resilience to texture information loss.

摘要（中文）：源自大规模视频生成式预训练的世界模型已成为通用机器人策略学习的一种有前景范式。然而，标准方法往往关注高保真RGB视频预测，这可能导致对无关因素的过度拟合，例如动态背景和光照变化。这些干扰因素会削弱模型的泛化能力，最终产生不可靠且脆弱的控制策略。为解决这一问题，我们提出了掩码世界模型（MWM），该模型利用视频扩散架构预测语义掩码的演化而非像素级变化。这种转换形成了几何信息瓶颈，迫使模型在过滤视觉噪声的同时捕捉基本的物理动态和接触关系。我们将此掩码动态骨干网络与基于扩散的策略头无缝集成，实现了鲁棒的端到端控制。大量实验评估表明，MWM在LIBERO和RLBench仿真基准测试中展现出卓越性能，显著优于当前最先进的基于RGB的世界模型。此外，真实世界实验和鲁棒性评估（通过随机令牌剪枝）表明，MWM具有优异的泛化能力，并对纹理信息丢失展现出强劲的抵御力。

Authors: Yunfan Lou, Xiaowei Chi, Xiaojie Zhang, Zezhong Qian, Chengxuan Li, Rongyu Zhang, Yaoxu Lyu, Guoyu Song, Chuyao Fu, Haoxuan Xu, Pengwei Wang, Shanghang Zhang

Learning Hybrid-Control Policies for High-Precision In-Contact Manipulation Under Uncertainty

简要说明：该论文提出了一种名为MATCH的方法，用于学习混合位置-力控制策略，以应对高精度接触式操作任务，如易碎的轴孔装配。实验表明，在模拟和真实世界中，该方法在成功率、数据效率和安全性方面均优于纯位置控制和可变阻抗策略。

TLDR: This paper introduces MATCH, a method to learn hybrid position-force control policies for high-precision in-contact manipulation tasks like fragile peg-in-hole, demonstrating improved success rates and safety over pose-only and variable impedance policies in both simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning-based control policies have been frequently demonstrated to be more effective than analytical techniques for many manipulation tasks. Commonly, these methods learn neural control policies that predict end-effector pose changes directly from observed state information. For tasks like inserting delicate connectors which induce force constraints, pose-based policies have limited explicit control over force and rely on carefully tuned low-level controllers to avoid executing damaging actions. In this work, we present hybrid position-force control policies that learn to dynamically select when to use force or position control in each control dimension. To improve learning efficiency of these policies, we introduce Mode-Aware Training for Contact Handling (MATCH) which adjusts policy action probabilities to explicitly mirror the mode selection behavior in hybrid control. We validate MATCH's learned policy effectiveness using fragile peg-in-hole tasks under extreme localization uncertainty. We find MATCH substantially outperforms pose-control policies -- solving these tasks with up to 10% higher success rates and 5x fewer peg breaks than pose-only policies under common types of state estimation error. MATCH also demonstrates data efficiency equal to pose-control policies, despite learning in a larger and more complex action space. In over 1600 sim-to-real experiments, we find MATCH succeeds twice as often as pose policies in high noise settings (33% vs.~68%) and applies ~30% less force on average compared to variable impedance policies on a Franka FR3 in laboratory conditions.

摘要（中文）：基于强化学习的控制策略在许多操作任务中已被频繁证明比解析技术更为有效。通常，这些方法学习神经控制策略，直接根据观察到的状态信息预测末端执行器位姿变化。然而，对于如插入精密连接件这类涉及力约束的任务，基于位姿的策略对力的显式控制有限，往往依赖精心调校的低级控制器来避免执行破坏性动作。本研究提出了一种混合位置-力控制策略，它能够学习如何动态选择在每个控制维度上何时使用力控制或位置控制。为了提升这些策略的学习效率，我们引入了面向接触处理的模式感知训练（MATCH），该方法通过调整策略动作概率，显式地反映混合控制中的模式选择行为。我们在极端定位不确定性条件下，使用精细插孔任务验证了MATCH所学习策略的有效性。结果表明，在常见类型的状态估计误差下，MATCH显著优于纯位姿控制策略——其任务成功率提升高达10%，且插孔破损次数减少至原策略的五分之一。尽管学习过程涉及更大、更复杂的动作空间，MATCH仍表现出与位姿控制策略相当的数据效率。在超过1600次仿真到真实的实验中，我们发现在高噪声环境下，MATCH的成功率是位姿策略的两倍（33%对比68%），并且在实验室条件下，相较于可变阻抗策略，其在Franka FR3机器人上施加的平均力减少约30%。

Authors: Hunter L. Brown, Geoffrey Hollinger, Stefan Lee

LiveVLN: Breaking the Stop-and-Go Loop in Vision-Language Navigation

简要说明：LiveVLN 是一个无需训练的新框架，旨在减少视觉语言导航中的停顿，它通过将动作执行与新观察的处理重叠，在不损失性能的情况下实现更流畅的在线导航。

TLDR: LiveVLN is a training-free framework that reduces stop-and-go motion in Vision-Language Navigation by overlapping action execution with observation processing, enabling smoother online execution without degrading benchmark performance.

Abstract: Recent navigation systems achieve strong benchmark results, yet real-world deployment often remains visibly stop-and-go. This bottleneck arises because the sense-inference-execution loop is still blocking: after each new observation, the controller must wait for sensing, transmission, and inference before motion can continue. Reducing action-generation cost alone therefore does not remove redundant waiting. To address this issue, we present LiveVLN, a training-free framework for more continuous embodied navigation by augmenting pretrained VLM navigators with multi-step action continuation. Instead of pausing for each full sense-and-inference round, LiveVLN overlaps execution with the processing of newly arrived observations, allowing refreshed future actions to be handed off before the current executable prefix is exhausted. This design keeps actions continuously available during motion, reducing idle waiting and enabling smoother online execution. The framework operates at runtime and can be integrated with compatible pretrained VLM navigators. Across R2R and RxR, LiveVLN preserves benchmark performance while reducing waiting time and improving action availability. In real-world deployments, it cuts average episode waiting time by up to $77.7\%$ and shortens wall-clock episode time by $12.6\%$ on StreamVLN and $19.6\%$ on NaVIDA, yielding more coherent execution during deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/NIneeeeeem/LiveVLN.

摘要（中文）：近期导航系统在基准测试中表现优异，但在实际部署中仍频繁出现明显的启停现象。这一瓶颈源于感知-推理-执行的循环仍是阻塞式的：每次获得新观测后，控制器必须等待感知、传输和推理过程完成后才能继续运动。因此，仅降低动作生成成本无法消除冗余等待。为解决此问题，我们提出LiveVLN——一种无需额外训练即可实现更连续具身导航的框架，通过为预训练视觉语言模型导航器增加多步动作延续能力来实现。与每次都需要暂停以完成完整感知-推理循环不同，LiveVLN将执行过程与新到达的观测处理相重叠，使得在可执行的前序动作耗尽前就能传递更新后的未来动作。该设计确保在运动过程中持续提供可用动作，减少空闲等待时间并实现更流畅的在线执行。该框架在运行时操作，可与兼容的预训练视觉语言模型导航器集成。在R2R和RxR数据集上的实验表明，LiveVLN在保持基准性能的同时显著减少了等待时间并提升了动作可用性。在实际部署中，该框架将平均任务等待时间降低高达77.7%，在StreamVLN和NaVIDA平台上的任务实际耗时分别缩短12.6%和19.6%，从而在部署过程中实现更连贯的执行。代码已开源：https://github.com/NIneeeeeem/LiveVLN。

Authors: Xiangchen Wang, Weiye Zhu, Teng Wang, TianTian Geng, Zekai Zhang, Zhiyuan Qi, Jinyu Yang, Feng Zheng

GenerativeMPC: VLM-RAG-guided Whole-Body MPC with Virtual Impedance for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation

简要说明：提出一个框架，使用结合检索增强生成的视觉语言模型为全身模型预测控制器生成动态约束和阻抗参数，实现安全、情境感知的双臂移动操作。

TLDR: A framework that uses a VLM with RAG to generate dynamic constraints and impedance parameters for a whole-body MPC controller, enabling safe, context-aware bimanual mobile manipulation.

Abstract: Bimanual mobile manipulation requires a seamless integration between high-level semantic reasoning and safe, compliant physical interaction - a challenge that end-to-end models approach opaquely and classical controllers lack the context to address. This paper presents GenerativeMPC, a hierarchical cyber-physical framework that explicitly bridges semantic scene understanding with physical control parameters for bimanual mobile manipulators. The system utilizes a Vision-Language Model with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VLM-RAG) to translate visual and linguistic context into grounded control constraints, specifically outputting dynamic velocity limits and safety margins for a Whole-Body Model Predictive Controller (MPC). Simultaneously, the VLM-RAG module modulates virtual stiffness and damping gains for a unified impedance-admittance controller, enabling context-aware compliance during human-robot interaction. Our framework leverages an experience-driven vector database to ensure consistent parameter grounding without retraining. Experimental results in MuJoCo, IsaacSim, and on a physical bimanual platform confirm a 60% speed reduction near humans and safe, socially-aware navigation and manipulation through semantic-to-physical parameter grounding. This work advances the field of human-centric cybernetics by grounding large-scale cognitive models into predictable, high-frequency physical control loops.

摘要（中文）：双手移动操作需要将高层语义推理与安全、顺应性的物理交互无缝集成，这一挑战对于端到端模型而言处理过程不透明，而传统控制器又缺乏情境理解能力。本文提出GenerativeMPC，一种分层信息物理框架，通过显式构建语义场景理解与双手移动机械臂物理控制参数之间的桥梁。该系统采用具备检索增强生成能力的视觉语言模型，将视觉与语言语境转化为具身控制约束，具体通过动态输出全身模型预测控制器的速度限制与安全边界。同时，该VLM-RAG模块可调节统一阻抗-导纳控制器的虚拟刚度与阻尼系数，实现人机交互过程中的情境感知顺应控制。本框架通过经验驱动的向量数据库确保参数具身化的一致性，无需重新训练模型。在MuJoCo、IsaacSim仿真环境及实体双手移动平台上的实验表明：通过语义到物理参数的具身化映射，系统在接近人类时可实现60%的速度衰减，并完成安全、具备社会意识的导航与操作任务。本研究通过将大规模认知模型嵌入可预测的高频物理控制回路，推动了以人为中心的信息物理系统领域的发展。

Authors: Marcelino Julio Fernando, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Jeffrin Sam, Yara Mahmoud, Konstantin Gubernatorov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Multi-Gait Learning for Humanoid Robots Using Reinforcement Learning with Selective Adversarial Motion Prior

简要说明：本文提出了一种选择性对抗运动先验策略，使仿人机器人能够通过强化学习掌握多种不同的步态，并实现了零样本的模拟到真实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces a selective Adversarial Motion Prior strategy to enable a humanoid robot to learn multiple distinct gaits using reinforcement learning, with a zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Learning diverse locomotion skills for humanoid robots in a unified reinforcement learning framework remains challenging due to the conflicting requirements of stability and dynamic expressiveness across different gaits. We present a multi-gait learning approach that enables a humanoid robot to master five distinct gaits -- walking, goose-stepping, running, stair climbing, and jumping -- using a consistent policy structure, action space, and reward formulation. The key contribution is a selective Adversarial Motion Prior (AMP) strategy: AMP is applied to periodic, stability-critical gaits (walking, goose-stepping, stair climbing) where it accelerates convergence and suppresses erratic behavior, while being deliberately omitted for highly dynamic gaits (running, jumping) where its regularization would over-constrain the motion. Policies are trained via PPO with domain randomization in simulation and deployed on a physical 12-DOF humanoid robot through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. Quantitative comparisons demonstrate that selective AMP outperforms a uniform AMP policy across all five gaits, achieving faster convergence, lower tracking error, and higher success rates on stability-focused gaits without sacrificing the agility required for dynamic ones.

摘要（中文）：让人形机器人在统一的强化学习框架中学习多种运动技能仍具挑战，这主要源于不同步态对稳定性与动态表现力存在矛盾需求。本文提出一种多步态学习方法，使机器人能够使用一致的动作空间、策略结构和奖励机制，掌握五种不同步态——行走、正步走、奔跑、爬楼梯和跳跃。其核心贡献在于一种选择性对抗性运动先验策略：该方法被应用于周期性且对稳定性要求高的步态（行走、正步走、爬楼梯），以加速收敛并抑制异常动作；而对于高动态性步态（奔跑、跳跃），则刻意省略该策略，避免其正则化作用对运动产生过度约束。策略通过带领域随机化的近端策略优化算法在仿真环境中训练，并借助零样本仿真到现实的迁移技术部署于一台12自由度实体人形机器人。定量对比实验表明，选择性对抗性运动先验策略在全部五种步态上均优于统一使用该策略的方法，实现了更快的收敛速度、更低的跟踪误差，并在强调稳定性的步态上获得更高的成功率，同时不牺牲动态步态所需的敏捷性。

Authors: Yuanye Wu, Keyi Wang, Linqi Ye, Boyang Xing

UniT: Toward a Unified Physical Language for Human-to-Humanoid Policy Learning and World Modeling

简要说明：UniT 提出了一种统一的物理语言，通过交叉重建机制将人类数据转移到人形机器人，在策略学习和世界建模中实现了最先进的数据效率和零样本迁移。

TLDR: UniT introduces a unified physical language for transferring human data to humanoid robots via a cross-reconstruction mechanism, achieving state-of-the-art data efficiency and zero-shot transfer in policy learning and world modeling.

Abstract: Scaling humanoid foundation models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of robotic data. While massive egocentric human data offers a scalable alternative, bridging the cross-embodiment chasm remains a fundamental challenge due to kinematic mismatches. We introduce UniT (Unified Latent Action Tokenizer via Visual Anchoring), a framework that establishes a unified physical language for human-to-humanoid transfer. Grounded in the philosophy that heterogeneous kinematics share universal visual consequences, UniT employs a tri-branch cross-reconstruction mechanism: actions predict vision to anchor kinematics to physical outcomes, while vision reconstructs actions to filter out irrelevant visual confounders. Concurrently, a fusion branch synergies these purified modalities into a shared discrete latent space of embodiment-agnostic physical intents. We validate UniT across two paradigms: 1) Policy Learning (VLA-UniT): By predicting these unified tokens, it effectively leverages diverse human data to achieve state-of-the-art data efficiency and robust out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on both humanoid simulation benchmark and real-world deployments, notably demonstrating zero-shot task transfer. 2) World Modeling (WM-UniT): By aligning cross-embodiment dynamics via unified tokens as conditions, it realizes direct human-to-humanoid action transfer. This alignment ensures that human data seamlessly translates into enhanced action controllability for humanoid video generation. Ultimately, by inducing a highly aligned cross-embodiment representation (empirically verified by t-SNE visualizations revealing the convergence of human and humanoid features into a shared manifold), UniT offers a scalable path to distill vast human knowledge into general-purpose humanoid capabilities.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人基础模型的规模化发展受限于机器人数据的稀缺性。尽管海量的第一人称人类数据提供了可扩展的替代方案，但由于运动学差异，跨越不同形态的鸿沟仍然是根本性挑战。我们提出UniT（基于视觉锚定的统一潜在动作分词器）框架，构建了用于人类向人形机器人迁移的统一物理语言。基于"异构运动学具有普适视觉结果"的核心思想，UniT采用三支路交叉重构机制：动作分支通过预测视觉结果将运动学锚定于物理效应，视觉分支则通过重构动作过滤无关视觉干扰。同时，融合分支将这些净化的模态协同编码至共享的离散潜在空间，形成与形态无关的物理意图表达。我们通过两种范式验证UniT：1）策略学习（VLA-UniT）：通过预测这些统一标记，模型能有效利用多样化人类数据，在人形机器人仿真基准和实际部署中实现最先进的数据效率与强健的分布外泛化能力，显著展现出零样本任务迁移特性。2）世界建模（WM-UniT）：通过以统一标记为条件对齐跨形态动态系统，实现直接的人类到人形机器人动作迁移。这种对齐确保人类数据可无缝转化为增强的人形机器人动作可控性，用于视频生成。最终，通过诱导高度对齐的跨形态表征（经t-SNE可视化实证验证，显示人类与人形机器人特征收敛至共享流形），UniT为将海量人类知识提炼为通用人形机器人能力提供了可扩展的路径。

Authors: Boyu Chen, Yi Chen, Lu Qiu, Jerry Bai, Yuying Ge, Yixiao Ge

VLA Foundry: A Unified Framework for Training Vision-Language-Action Models

简要说明：VLA Foundry 是一个用于训练视觉-语言-动作模型的统一开源框架，从语言模型预训练到动作微调，通过训练在机器人操作模拟器基准上表现优异的模型来展示其效用。

TLDR: VLA Foundry is a unified open-source framework for training Vision-Language-Action models, from LLM pretraining to action fine-tuning, and it demonstrates its utility by training models that show strong performance on a robotic manipulation simulator benchmark.

Abstract: We present VLA Foundry, an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase. Most open-source VLA efforts specialize on the action training stage, often stitching together incompatible pretraining pipelines. VLA Foundry instead provides a shared training stack with end-to-end control, from language pretraining to action-expert fine-tuning. VLA Foundry supports both from-scratch training and pretrained backbones from Hugging Face. To demonstrate the utility of our framework, we train and release two types of models: the first trained fully from scratch through our LLM-->VLM-->VLA pipeline and the second built on the pretrained Qwen3-VL backbone. We evaluate closed-loop policy performance of both models on LBM Eval, an open-data, open-source simulator. We also contribute usability improvements to the simulator and the STEP analysis tools for easier public use. In the nominal evaluation setting, our fully-open from-scratch model is on par with our prior closed-source work and substituting in the Qwen3-VL backbone leads to a strong multi-task table top manipulation policy outperforming our baseline by a wide margin. The VLA Foundry codebase is available at https://github.com/TRI-ML/vla_foundry and all multi-task model weights are released on https://huggingface.co/collections/TRI-ML/vla-foundry. Additional qualitative videos are available on the project website https://tri-ml.github.io/vla_foundry.

摘要（中文）：我们推出VLA Foundry，这是一个开源框架，统一了LLM、VLM和VLA的训练于单一代码库中。多数开源VLA工作专注于动作训练阶段，通常将不兼容的预训练流程拼接在一起。而VLA Foundry提供了一个端到端控制的共享训练栈，涵盖从语言预训练到动作专家微调的全过程。VLA Foundry支持从头训练和基于Hugging Face预训练骨干网络的训练。为展示本框架的实用性，我们训练并发布了两类模型：第一类通过我们的LLM→VLM→VLA流程完全从头训练；第二类基于预训练的Qwen3-VL骨干网络构建。我们在LBM Eval（一个开放数据、开源的模拟器）上评估了这两类模型的闭环策略性能。我们还改进了模拟器和STEP分析工具的用户友好性，以方便公众使用。在标准评估设置中，我们完全开源的从头训练模型与先前闭源工作表现相当，而采用Qwen3-VL骨干网络则产生了一个强大的多任务桌面操作策略，其性能远超基线模型。VLA Foundry代码库发布于https://github.com/TRI-ML/vla_foundry，所有多任务模型权重发布于https://huggingface.co/collections/TRI-ML/vla-foundry。更多定性视频可在项目网站https://tri-ml.github.io/vla_foundry上查看。

Authors: Jean Mercat, Sedrick Keh, Kushal Arora, Isabella Huang, Paarth Shah, Haruki Nishimura, Shun Iwase, Katherine Liu

Multi-Cycle Spatio-Temporal Adaptation in Human-Robot Teaming

简要说明：RAPIDDS 是一个人机协作框架，它通过多周期建模个体的空间行为（运动路径）和时间行为（任务完成时间），联合优化任务调度和机器人运动，以提高效率并减少近距离干扰。

TLDR: RAPIDDS is a framework for human-robot teaming that jointly adapts task schedules and robot motion plans by modeling an individual's spatial and temporal behavior over multiple cycles to improve efficiency and minimize proximity.

Abstract: Effective human-robot teaming is crucial for the practical deployment of robots in human workspaces. However, optimizing joint human-robot plans remains a challenge due to the difficulty of modeling individualized human capabilities and preferences. While prior research has leveraged the multi-cycle structure of domains like manufacturing to learn an individual's tendencies and adapt plans over repeated interactions, these techniques typically consider task-level and motion-level adaptation in isolation. Task-level methods optimize allocation and scheduling but often ignore spatial interference in close-proximity scenarios; conversely, motion-level methods focus on collision avoidance while ignoring the broader task context. This paper introduces RAPIDDS, a framework that unifies these approaches by modeling an individual's spatial behavior (motion paths) and temporal behavior (time required to complete tasks) over multiple cycles. RAPIDDS then jointly adapts task schedules and steers diffusion models of robot motions to maximize efficiency and minimize proximity accounting for these individualized models. We demonstrate the importance of this dual adaptation through an ablation study in simulation and a physical robot scenario using a 7-DOF robot arm. Finally, we present a user study (n=32) showing significant plan improvement compared to non-adaptive systems across both objective metrics, such as efficiency and proximity, and subjective measures, including fluency and user preference. See this paper's companion video at: https://youtu.be/55Q3lq1fINs.

摘要（中文）：有效的人机协作对于机器人实际部署于人类工作空间至关重要。然而，由于个体人类能力与偏好的建模难度，优化人机联合规划仍面临挑战。现有研究虽利用制造等多周期领域的结构特性，通过重复交互学习个体行为倾向并调整规划，但这些技术通常孤立地考虑任务层面与运动层面的适应机制。任务层方法侧重于优化任务分配与调度，但常忽略近距离场景中的空间干涉；运动层方法则聚焦于避碰规划，却忽视了更广泛的任务背景。本文提出RAPIDDS框架，通过多周期建模个体的空间行为（运动路径）与时间行为（任务完成所需时长），将两种方法进行统一。RAPIDDS在此基础上联合调整任务调度并引导机器人运动扩散模型，以基于个体化模型实现效率最大化与近距离接触最小化。我们通过仿真消融实验和7自由度机械臂实物场景验证了双重适应机制的重要性，并开展用户研究（n=32）表明：相较于非自适应系统，本方法在效率、距离等客观指标及流畅性、用户偏好等主观维度上均实现显著提升。完整演示视频见：https://youtu.be/55Q3lq1fINs

Authors: Alex Cuellar, Michael Hagenow, Julie Shah

SafetyALFRED: Evaluating Safety-Conscious Planning of Multimodal Large Language Models

简要说明：SafetyALFRED 是在具身智能基准 ALFRED 上构建的新基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型通过规划识别和主动缓解现实世界厨房危险的能力。

TLDR: SafetyALFRED is a new benchmark built on the embodied AI benchmark ALFRED to evaluate the ability of multimodal LLMs to recognize and actively mitigate real-world kitchen hazards through planning.

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models are increasingly adopted as autonomous agents in interactive environments, yet their ability to proactively address safety hazards remains insufficient. We introduce SafetyALFRED, built upon the embodied agent benchmark ALFRED, augmented with six categories of real-world kitchen hazards. While existing safety evaluations focus on hazard recognition through disembodied question answering (QA) settings, we evaluate eleven state-of-the-art models from the Qwen, Gemma, and Gemini families on not only hazard recognition, but also active risk mitigation through embodied planning. Our experimental results reveal a significant alignment gap: while models can accurately recognize hazards in QA settings, average mitigation success rates for these hazards are low in comparison. Our findings demonstrate that static evaluations through QA are insufficient for physical safety, thus we advocate for a paradigm shift toward benchmarks that prioritize corrective actions in embodied contexts. We open-source our code and dataset under https://github.com/sled-group/SafetyALFRED.git

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型正日益作为自主智能体应用于交互环境中，但其主动应对安全隐患的能力仍显不足。本研究在具身智能体基准ALFRED的基础上构建了SafetyALFRED，新增了六类真实厨房危险场景。现有安全评估多通过非具身问答形式关注危险识别，而我们对Qwen、Gemma和Gemini系列的十一个前沿模型进行了全面评估，不仅涵盖危险识别能力，更着重考察其通过具身规划主动化解风险的能力。实验结果显示显著的性能差异：模型在问答场景中能准确识别危险，但针对这些危险的平均风险缓解成功率却相对较低。我们的研究表明，通过问答进行的静态评估不足以衡量物理安全能力，因此我们倡导评估范式应向强调具身情境中纠正性行动的基准体系转变。相关代码与数据集已在https://github.com/sled-group/SafetyALFRED.git开源。

Authors: Josue Torres-Fonseca, Naihao Deng, Yinpei Dai, Shane Storks, Yichi Zhang, Rada Mihalcea, Casey Kennington, Joyce Chai

Assessing VLM-Driven Semantic-Affordance Inference for Non-Humanoid Robot Morphologies

简要说明：本研究探索了视觉语言模型在非人形机器人形态的可用性推理能力，发现其倾向于过于保守的预测，需辅以其他方法以实现安全有效的机器人集成。

TLDR: This paper investigates the ability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to infer affordances for robots with non-humanoid morphologies, identifying a tendency towards over-conservative predictions that require complementary approaches for safe and effective robotic integration.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding human-object interactions, but their application to robotic systems with non-humanoid morphologies remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether VLMs can effectively infer affordances for robots with fundamentally different embodiments than humans, addressing a critical gap in the deployment of these models for diverse robotic applications. We introduce a novel hybrid dataset that combines annotated real-world robotic affordance-object relations with VLM-generated synthetic scenarios, and perform an empirical analysis of VLM performance across multiple object categories and robot morphologies, revealing significant variations in affordance inference capabilities. Our experiments demonstrate that while VLMs show promising generalisation to non-humanoid robot forms, their performance is notably inconsistent across different object domains. Critically, we identify a consistent pattern of low false positive rates but high false negative rates across all morphologies and object categories, indicating that VLMs tend toward conservative affordance predictions. Our analysis reveals that this pattern is particularly pronounced for novel tool use scenarios and unconventional object manipulations, suggesting that effective integration of VLMs in robotic systems requires complementary approaches to mitigate over-conservative behaviour while preserving the inherent safety benefits of low false positive rates.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型在理解人-物交互方面展现出卓越能力，但其在非人形形态机器人系统中的应用仍处于探索阶段。本研究旨在探究视觉语言模型能否有效推断与人类形态截然不同的机器人的可供性，以填补这些模型在多样化机器人应用部署中的关键空白。我们引入一种新型混合数据集，结合标注的现实世界机器人可供性-物体关系与视觉语言模型生成的合成场景，并通过多物体类别与机器人形态的实证分析，揭示视觉语言模型可供性推断能力的显著差异。实验表明，虽然视觉语言模型对非人形机器人形态展现出良好的泛化能力，但其在不同物体领域的表现存在明显的不一致性。关键发现是，所有形态与物体类别均呈现出低误报率与高漏报率的一致性模式，表明视觉语言模型倾向于保守的可供性预测。进一步分析发现，该模式在新型工具使用场景与非传统物体操作中尤为明显，这意味着要将视觉语言模型有效整合至机器人系统，需要采用互补性方法以缓解过度保守行为，同时保留低误报率带来的固有安全性优势。

Authors: Jess Jones, Raul Santos-Rodriguez, Sabine Hauert

Wrench-Aware Admittance Control for Unknown-Payload Manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于UR5e机器人的力矩感知导纳控制框架，通过使用力-力矩测量来估计和补偿未知负载的质量和质心偏移，以提高拾取-放置操作性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a wrench-aware admittance control framework for a UR5e robot to improve pick-and-place manipulation with unknown payloads by using force-torque measurements to estimate and compensate for the payload's mass and center of mass offset.

Abstract: Unknown payloads can strongly affect compliant robotic manipulation, especially when the payload center of mass is not aligned with the tool center point. In this case, the payload generates an offset wrench at the robot wrist. During motion, this wrench is not only related to payload weight, but also to payload inertia. If it is not modeled, the compliant controller can interpret it as an external interaction wrench, which causes unintended compliant motion, larger tracking error, and reduced transport accuracy. This paper presents a wrench-aware admittance control framework for unknown-payload pick-and-place using a UR5e robot. The method uses force-torque measurements in two different roles. First, a three-axis translational excitation term is used to reduce payload-induced force effects during transport without making the robot excessively stiff. Second, after grasping, the controller first estimates payload mass for transport compensation and then estimates the payload CoM offset relative to the TCP using wrist force-torque measurements collected during the subsequent translational motion. This helps improve object placement and stacking behavior. Experimental results show improved transport and placement performance compared with uncorrected placement while preserving compliant motion.

摘要（中文）：未知负载会显著影响柔性机器人的操作性能，尤其是在负载质心与工具中心点未对齐的情况下。此时，负载会在机器人腕部产生偏移力矩。在运动过程中，该力矩不仅与负载重量有关，还取决于负载的惯性特性。若未对此进行建模，柔性控制器可能将其误判为外部交互力矩，导致非预期的柔性运动、增大跟踪误差并降低运送精度。本文提出一种基于力矩感知的导纳控制框架，用于UR5e机器人执行未知负载的抓放任务。该方法通过两种不同方式利用力-力矩测量数据：首先，通过三轴平移激励项在不使机器人过度刚性的前提下，减少运输过程中负载引起的力效应；其次，在抓取后，控制器先估算负载质量用于运输补偿，随后利用后续平移运动中采集的腕部力-力矩数据，估算负载相对于工具中心点的质心偏移量。该机制有助于提升物体放置与堆叠行为的精确性。实验结果表明，相比未校正的放置方式，该方法在保持柔性运动特性的同时，显著提升了运输与放置性能。

Authors: Hossein Gholampour, Logan E. Beaver

M$^{2}$GRPO: Mamba-based Multi-Agent Group Relative Policy Optimization for Biomimetic Underwater Robots Pursuit

简要说明：本文提出了M$^{2}$GRPO，一种基于Mamba的多智能体强化学习方法，用于仿生水下机器人的协同追捕任务，在模拟和真实水池实验中均显示出性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes M$^{2}$GRPO, a Mamba-based multi-agent reinforcement learning method for cooperative pursuit tasks with biomimetic underwater robots, showing improvements in simulation and real-world pool experiments.

Abstract: Traditional policy learning methods in cooperative pursuit face fundamental challenges in biomimetic underwater robots, where long-horizon decision making, partial observability, and inter-robot coordination require both expressiveness and stability. To address these issues, a novel framework called Mamba-based multi-agent group relative policy optimization (M$^{2}$GRPO) is proposed, which integrates a selective state-space Mamba policy with group-relative policy optimization under the centralized-training and decentralized-execution (CTDE) paradigm. Specifically, the Mamba-based policy leverages observation history to capture long-horizon temporal dependencies and exploits attention-based relational features to encode inter-agent interactions, producing bounded continuous actions through normalized Gaussian sampling. To further improve credit assignment without sacrificing stability, the group-relative advantages are obtained by normalizing rewards across agents within each episode and optimized through a multi-agent extension of GRPO, significantly reducing the demand for training resources while enabling stable and scalable policy updates. Extensive simulations and real-world pool experiments across team scales and evader strategies demonstrate that M$^{2}$GRPO consistently outperforms MAPPO and recurrent baselines in both pursuit success rate and capture efficiency. Overall, the proposed framework provides a practical and scalable solution for cooperative underwater pursuit with biomimetic robot systems.

摘要（中文）：传统协同追捕策略学习方法在仿生水下机器人中面临根本性挑战，其长时决策、部分可观测性与机器人间协调能力对策略的表达性与稳定性提出了双重需求。为解决这些问题，本文提出一种基于Mamba的多智能体群组相对策略优化（M$^{2}$GRPO）框架，该框架在中心化训练与分散执行（CTDE）范式下，将选择性状态空间Mamba策略与群组相对策略优化相结合。具体而言，基于Mamba的策略利用观测历史捕捉长时程时序依赖关系，通过基于注意力的关系特征编码智能体间交互，并采用归一化高斯采样生成有界连续动作。为在不牺牲稳定性的前提下提升信用分配效果，该框架通过归一化单回合内智能体间奖励获得群组相对优势值，并借助GRPO的多智能体扩展进行优化，在保障策略更新稳定性和可扩展性的同时显著降低训练资源需求。跨团队规模与逃避策略的大规模仿真及真实水池实验表明，M$^{2}$GRPO在追捕成功率和捕获效率方面均持续优于MAPPO及循环基线方法。总体而言，该框架为仿生机器人系统的协同水下追捕任务提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

Authors: Yukai Feng, Zhiheng Wu, Zhengxing Wu, Junwen Gu, Junzhi Yu

Quadruped Parkour Learning: Sparsely Gated Mixture of Experts with Visual Input

简要说明：本研究将稀疏门控的专家混合（MoE）架构应用于基于视觉的四足机器人跑酷，在真实机器人上证明了其相对于标准MLP的性能与效率提升。

TLDR: This paper applies sparsely gated Mixture of Experts architectures to vision-based quadruped parkour, demonstrating improved performance and efficiency over standard MLPs on a real robot.

Abstract: Robotic parkour provides a compelling benchmark for advancing locomotion over highly challenging terrain, including large discontinuities such as elevated steps. Recent approaches have demonstrated impressive capabilities, including dynamic climbing and jumping, but typically rely on sequential multilayer perceptron (MLP) architectures with densely activated layers. In contrast, sparsely gated mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures have emerged in the large language model domain as an effective paradigm for improving scalability and performance by activating only a subset of parameters at inference time. In this work, we investigate the application of sparsely gated MoE architectures to vision-based robotic parkour. We compare control policies based on standard MLPs and MoE architectures under a controlled setting where the number of active parameters at inference time is matched. Experimental results on a real Unitree Go2 quadruped robot demonstrate clear performance gains, with the MoE policy achieving double the number of successful trials in traversing large obstacles compared to a standard MLP baseline. We further show that achieving comparable performance with a standard MLP requires scaling its parameter count to match that of the total MoE model, resulting in a 14.3\% increase in computation time. These results highlight that sparsely gated MoE architectures provide a favorable trade-off between performance and computational efficiency, enabling improved scaling of control policies for vision-based robotic parkour. An anonymized link to the codebase is https://osf.io/v2kqj/files/github?view_only=7977dee10c0a44769184498eaba72e44.

摘要（中文）：机器人跑酷为推动在极具挑战性地形（包括高台阶等大型不连续结构）上的运动能力提供了一个引人注目的基准。近期研究已展示出令人印象深刻的能力，包括动态攀爬和跳跃，但通常依赖于具有密集激活层的顺序多层感知机（MLP）架构。相比之下，稀疏门控专家混合（MoE）架构在大型语言模型领域崭露头角，通过在推理时仅激活部分参数，成为提升可扩展性和性能的有效范式。本研究探讨了稀疏门控MoE架构在基于视觉的机器人跑酷中的应用。我们在推理时激活参数数量受控的设定下，对比了基于标准MLP和MoE架构的控制策略。在真实Unitree Go2四足机器人上的实验结果表明，MoE策略在跨越大型障碍物时取得了明显性能提升，其成功试验次数达到标准MLP基准的两倍。我们进一步证明，标准MLP要达到可比性能需要将其参数规模扩展至与MoE模型总量相匹配，这会导致计算时间增加14.3%。这些结果凸显了稀疏门控MoE架构在性能与计算效率之间提供了更优的平衡，使得基于视觉的机器人跑酷控制策略具备更好的可扩展性。代码库的匿名链接为：https://osf.io/v2kqj/files/github?view_only=7977dee10c0a44769184498eaba72e44。

Authors: Michael Ziegltrum, Jianhao Jiao, Tianhu Peng, Chengxu Zhou, Dimitrios Kanoulas

Warmth and Competence in the Swarm: Designing Effective Human-Robot Teams

简要说明：本研究探讨了机器人集群的社会感知（基于其温暖度和能力的集体行为）如何影响人类偏好和团队效能，发现社交特质在人与机器人团队设计中可以超越纯粹的任务性能。

TLDR: This paper investigates how the social perception of robot swarms, specifically warmth and competence based on their collective behaviors, influences human preference and team effectiveness, finding that social traits can outweigh pure task performance in human-robot team design.

Abstract: As groups of robots increasingly collaborate with humans, understanding how humans perceive them is critical for designing effective human-robot teams. While prior research examined how humans interpret and evaluate the abilities and intentions of individual agents, social perception of robot teams remains relatively underexplored. Drawing on the competence-warmth framework, we conducted two studies manipulating swarm behaviors in completing a collective search task and measured the social perception of swarm behaviors when human participants are either observers (Study 1) and operators (Study 2). Across both studies, our results show that variations in swarm behaviors consistently influenced participants' perceptions of warmth and competence. Notably, longer broadcast durations increased perceived warmth; larger separation distances increased perceived competence. Interestingly, individual robot speed had no effect on either of the perceptions. Furthermore, our results show that these social perceptions predicted participants' team preferences more strongly than task performance. Participants preferred robot teams that were both warm and competent, not those that completed tasks most quickly. These findings demonstrate that human-robot interaction dynamically shapes social perception, underscoring the importance of integrating both technical and social considerations when designing robot swarms for effective human-robot collaboration.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人群体与人类的协作日益增多，理解人类如何感知机器人对于设计有效的人机团队至关重要。尽管已有研究探讨了人类如何解释和评估单个智能体的能力与意图，但对机器人团队的社会感知仍相对缺乏深入探索。基于能力-温暖度理论框架，我们通过两项研究，操控机器人群在完成集体搜索任务中的行为，并测量了人类参与者作为观察者（研究1）和操作者（研究2）时对群体行为的社会感知。两项研究的结果均表明，群体行为的变化持续影响参与者对温暖度和能力的感知。值得注意的是，较长的广播持续时间提升了感知温暖度；较大的个体间距增强了感知能力。有趣的是，单个机器人的速度对这两种感知均无影响。此外，我们的研究结果显示，这些社会感知对参与者团队偏好的预测力强于任务完成表现。参与者更倾向于选择既温暖又有能力的机器人团队，而非那些任务完成速度最快的团队。这些发现表明，人机交互动态地塑造着社会感知，强调了在设计用于有效人机协作的机器人群时，必须综合技术与社会因素的重要性。

Authors: Genki Miyauchi, Roderich Groß, Chaona Chen

Multimodal embodiment-aware navigation transformer

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于多模态Transformer的机器人导航策略ViLiNT。该策略融合RGB、LiDAR、目标表示和机器人本体描述符，通过扩散模型生成轨迹，并包含路径通过性预测模块以提高在分布变化下的鲁棒性，在仿真和真实世界部署中得到了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multimodal transformer-based policy, ViLiNT, for goal-conditioned robot navigation. It fuses RGB, LiDAR, goal, and robot embodiment descriptors to condition a diffusion model for trajectory generation, and includes a path clearance prediction head to improve robustness to distribution shifts, validated in simulation and real-world deployments.

Abstract: Goal-conditioned navigation models for ground robots trained using supervised learning show promising zero-shot transfer, but their collision-avoidance capability nevertheless degrades under distribution shift, i.e. environmental, robot or sensor configuration changes. We propose ViLiNT a multimodal, attention-based policy for goal navigation, trained on heterogeneous data from multiple platforms and environments, which improves robustness with two key features. First, we fuse RGB images, 3D LiDAR point clouds, a goal embedding and a robot's embodiment descriptor with a transformer architecture to capture complementary geometry and appearance cues. The transformer's output is used to condition a diffusion model that generates navigable trajectories. Second, using automatically generated offline labels, we train a path clearance prediction head for scoring and ranking trajectories produced by the diffusion model. The diffusion conditioning as well as the trajectory ranking head depend on a robot's embodiment token that allows our model to generate and select trajectories with respect to the robot's dimensions. Across three simulated environments, ViLiNT improves Success Rate on average by 166\% over equivalent state-of-the-art vision-only baseline (NoMaD). This increase in performance is confirmed through real-world deployments of a rover navigating in obstacle fields. These results highlight that combining multimodal fusion with our collision prediction mechanism leads to improved off-road navigation robustness.

摘要（中文）：基于监督学习训练的地面机器人目标导航模型在零样本迁移方面展现出良好前景，但其避障能力在分布偏移（如环境变化、机器人或传感器配置改变）下仍会退化。我们提出ViLiNT——一种基于注意力机制的多模态目标导航策略，该模型通过在多平台、多环境的异构数据上进行训练，凭借两大核心特征提升系统鲁棒性。首先，我们采用Transformer架构融合RGB图像、三维激光雷达点云、目标嵌入向量及机器人本体描述符，以捕捉互补的几何与外观特征。Transformer的输出用于调节扩散模型，生成可导航轨迹。其次，借助自动生成的离线标签，我们训练了轨迹通过性预测模块，用于对扩散模型生成的轨迹进行评分与排序。扩散条件调节与轨迹排序模块均依赖于机器人本体标识符，使模型能够根据机器人物理尺寸生成并筛选轨迹。在三个模拟环境中，ViLiNT相较于同等性能的纯视觉基线模型（NoMaD）平均将成功率提升166%。该性能提升在真实场景的越野机器人障碍场导航实验中得以验证。这些结果表明，多模态融合与碰撞预测机制的结合显著增强了越野导航系统的鲁棒性。

Authors: Louis Dezons, Quentin Picard, Rémi Marsal, François Goulette, David Filliat

RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：提出了RoboWM-Bench基准，用于评估视频世界模型在机器人操作中的物理合理性和可执行性，通过将生成的视频转换为可执行的机器人动作计划并在硬件上进行测试。

TLDR: Introduces RoboWM-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility and executability of video world model predictions in robotic manipulation, by converting generated videos into actionable robot plans and testing them on hardware.

Abstract: Recent advances in large-scale video world models have enabled increasingly realistic future prediction, raising the prospect of leveraging imagined videos for robot learning. However, visual realism does not imply physical plausibility, and behaviors inferred from generated videos may violate dynamics and fail when executed by embodied agents. Existing benchmarks begin to incorporate notions of physical plausibility, but they largely remain perception- or diagnostic-oriented and do not systematically evaluate whether predicted behaviors can be translated into executable actions that complete the intended task. To address this gap, we introduce RoboWM-Bench, a manipulation-centric benchmark for embodiment-grounded evaluation of video world models. RoboWM-Bench converts generated behaviors from both human-hand and robotic manipulation videos into embodied action sequences and validates them through robotic execution. The benchmark spans diverse manipulation scenarios and establishes a unified protocol for consistent and reproducible evaluation. Using RoboWM-Bench, we evaluate state-of-the-art video world models and find that reliably generating physically executable behaviors remains an open challenge. Common failure modes include errors in spatial reasoning, unstable contact prediction, and non-physical deformations. While finetuning on manipulation data yields improvements, physical inconsistencies still persist, suggesting opportunities for more physically grounded video generation for robots.

摘要（中文）：大规模视频世界模型的最新进展使得未来预测愈发逼真，这为利用生成视频进行机器人学习开辟了前景。然而，视觉真实性并不等同于物理合理性，从生成视频中推断出的行为可能违背动力学规律，在具身智能体执行时失败。现有基准开始纳入物理合理性的概念，但大多仍侧重于感知或诊断，并未系统评估预测行为能否转化为可执行动作以完成目标任务。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RoboWM-Bench——一个以操作为核心的基准，用于对视频世界模型进行具身化评估。该基准将人类手部与机器人操作视频中生成的行为转化为具身动作序列，并通过机器人执行进行验证。基准涵盖多样化操作场景，并建立了统一协议以实现一致且可复现的评估。借助RoboWM-Bench，我们对当前最先进的视频世界模型进行评估，发现可靠生成物理可执行行为仍是一个开放挑战。常见失败模式包括空间推理错误、接触预测不稳定以及非物理形变等问题。尽管在操作数据上进行微调能带来改进，但物理不一致性依然存在，这表明面向机器人的物理基础视频生成仍存在优化空间。

Authors: Feng Jiang, Yang Chen, Kyle Xu, Yuchen Liu, Haifeng Wang, Zhenhao Shen, Jasper Lu, Shengze Huang, Yuanfei Wang, Chen Xie, Ruihai Wu

AeroBridge-TTA: Test-Time Adaptive Language-Conditioned Control for UAVs

简要说明：一种通过测试时适应来改善语言引导无人机控制的方法，用于弥补计划轨迹与实际执行之间在真实世界动态不匹配下的差距。

TLDR: A method for improving language-guided UAV control by using test-time adaptation to bridge the gap between planned trajectories and actual execution under real-world dynamic mismatches.

Abstract: Language-guided unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) often fail not from bad reasoning or perception, but from execution mismatch: the gap between a planned trajectory and the controller's ability to track it when the real dynamics differ from training (mass changes, drag shifts, actuator delay, wind). We propose AeroBridge-TTA, a language-conditioned control pipeline that targets this gap with test-time adaptation. It has three parts: a language encoder that maps the command into a subgoal, an adaptive policy conditioned on the subgoal and a learned latent, and a test-time adaptation (TTA) module that updates the latent online from observed transitions. On five language-conditioned UAV tasks under 13 mismatch conditions with the same domain randomization, AeroBridge-TTA ties a strong PPO-MLP baseline in-distribution and wins all 5 out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, +22.0 pts on average (62.7% vs. 40.7%); the +8.5 pt overall gain comes entirely from the OOD regime. A same-weights ablation that only changes the step size $α$ shows the latent update itself is responsible for a $4.6\times$ OOD lift.

摘要（中文）：语言引导的无人机（UAV）在执行任务时，其失败原因往往并非源于推理或感知能力的缺陷，而是在于执行不匹配：当真实动力学特性与训练环境存在差异（如质量变化、阻力偏移、执行器延迟、风力干扰）时，规划轨迹与控制器实际跟踪能力之间存在差距。针对此问题，我们提出了一种名为AeroBridge-TTA的语言条件控制流程，其核心在于通过测试时自适应来弥合这一差距。该系统包含三个部分：将语言指令映射为子目标的语言编码器；基于子目标与学习隐状态进行条件调适的自适应策略；以及能够根据观测到的状态转移在线更新隐状态的测试时自适应模块。在13种相同域随机化生成的不匹配条件下，针对五项语言引导的无人机任务，AeroBridge-TTA在分布内条件下与性能强劲的PPO-MLP基线持平，并在全部5种分布外条件下表现更优，平均提升22.0个百分点（62.7% vs. 40.7%）；整体8.5个百分点的性能提升完全来源于分布外场景。仅通过调整步长$α$的等权重消融实验表明，隐状态更新机制本身即可带来$4.6\times$的分布外性能提升。

Authors: Lingxue Lyu

AI-Enabled Image-Based Hybrid Vision/Force Control of Tendon-Driven Aerial Continuum Manipulators

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于肌腱驱动空中连续体机械臂的AI赋能级联混合视觉/力控制框架，结合了级联快速固定时间滑模控制和径向基函数神经网络，以处理不确定性并实现自主物理交互，同时使用基于图神经网络线特征提取的视觉伺服框架。

TLDR: This paper proposes an AI-enabled hybrid vision/force control framework for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators, combining cascaded fast fixed-time sliding mode control with a radial basis function neural network to handle uncertainties and enable autonomous physical interaction using a visual servoing framework with graph neural network-based line feature extraction.

Abstract: This paper presents an AI-enabled cascaded hybrid vision/force control framework for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators based on constant-strain modeling in $SE(3)$ as a coupled system. The proposed controller is designed to enable autonomous, physical interaction with a static environment while stabilizing the image feature error. The developed strategy combines the cascaded fast fixed-time sliding mode control and a radial basis function neural network to cope with the uncertainties in the image acquired by the eye-in-hand monocular camera and the measurements from the force sensing apparatus. This ensures rapid, online learning of the vision- and force-related uncertainties without requiring offline training. Furthermore, the features are extracted via a state-of-the-art graph neural network architecture employed by a visual servoing framework using line features, rather than relying on heuristic geometric line extractors, to concurrently contribute to tracking the desired normal interaction force during contact and regulating the image feature error. A comparative study benchmarks the proposed controller against established rigid-arm aerial manipulation methods, evaluating robustness across diverse scenarios and feature extraction strategies. The simulation and experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed methodology under various initial conditions and demonstrate robust performance in executing manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于$SE(3)$空间恒定应变建模的肌腱驱动空中连续体机械臂AI赋能级联混合视觉/力控制框架。该控制器旨在实现与静态环境的自主物理交互，同时稳定图像特征误差。所提出的策略结合了级联快速固定时间滑模控制和径向基函数神经网络，以应对手眼单目相机采集图像及力传感装置测量中的不确定性，从而实现对视觉与力相关不确定性的快速在线学习，无需离线训练。此外，通过采用基于图神经网络的先进视觉伺服框架提取线特征，取代传统的启发式几何线提取器，该方法能够在接触过程中同步追踪期望法向交互力并调节图像特征误差。通过对比研究，将所提控制器与现有刚性臂空中操作方法进行基准测试，评估了不同场景和特征提取策略下的鲁棒性。仿真与实验结果验证了该方法在多种初始条件下的有效性，并展示了在执行操作任务时具有的稳健性能。

Authors: Shayan Sepahvand, Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi, Farhad Aghili

Gated Memory Policy

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于机器人操作的门控记忆策略（GMP），学习选择性回忆历史信息以处理马尔可夫和非马尔可夫任务，在新基准测试中提升了性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes a gated memory policy (GMP) for robotic manipulation, which learns to selectively recall historical information to handle both Markovian and non-Markovian tasks, improving performance on a new benchmark.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks exhibit varying memory requirements, ranging from Markovian tasks that require no memory to non-Markovian tasks that depend on historical information spanning single or multiple interaction trials. Surprisingly, simply extending observation histories of a visuomotor policy often leads to a significant performance drop due to distribution shift and overfitting. To address these issues, we propose Gated Memory Policy (GMP), a visuomotor policy that learns both when to recall memory and what to recall. To learn when to recall memory, GMP employs a learned memory gate mechanism that selectively activates history context only when necessary, improving robustness and reactivity. To learn what to recall efficiently, GMP introduces a lightweight cross-attention module that constructs effective latent memory representations. To further enhance robustness, GMP injects diffusion noise into historical actions, mitigating sensitivity to noisy or inaccurate histories during both training and inference. On our proposed non-Markovian benchmark MemMimic, GMP achieves a 30.1% average success rate improvement over long-history baselines, while maintaining competitive performance on Markovian tasks in RoboMimic. All code, data and in-the-wild deployment instructions are available on our project website https://gated-memory-policy.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作任务展现出不同的记忆需求，从无需记忆的马尔可夫任务到依赖于单个或多个交互试验历史信息的非马尔可夫任务。令人惊讶的是，单纯扩展视觉运动策略的观测历史常因分布偏移和过拟合导致性能显著下降。为解决这些问题，我们提出门控记忆策略（GMP）——一种能够同时学习何时调用记忆及调用何种记忆的视觉运动策略。为学习何时调用记忆，GMP采用可学习的记忆门控机制，仅在必要时选择性激活历史上下文，从而提升鲁棒性与反应能力。为高效学习调用何种记忆，GMP引入轻量级交叉注意力模块，构建有效的潜在记忆表征。为进一步增强鲁棒性，GMP在训练与推理过程中向历史动作注入扩散噪声，以降低对噪声或历史误差的敏感性。在我们提出的非马尔可夫基准测试MemMimic中，GMP相比长历史基线方法实现了30.1%的平均成功率提升，同时在RoboMimic的马尔可夫任务中保持竞争力。所有代码、数据及实际部署指南均发布于项目网站：https://gated-memory-policy.github.io/。

Authors: Yihuai Gao, Jinyun Liu, Shuang Li, Shuran Song

Task-Adaptive Admittance Control for Human-Quadrotor Cooperative Load Transportation with Dynamic Cable-Length Regulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人-四旋翼协作负载运输的新型导纳控制器，通过动态调节缆绳长度，使系统能够适应接触力，提高了安全性和响应性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel admittance controller for human-quadrotor cooperative load transportation, allowing the quadrotor and cable system to dynamically adapt to contact forces for improved safety and responsiveness.

Abstract: The collaboration between humans and robots is critical in many robotic applications, especially in those requiring physical human-robot interaction (pHRI). Previous research in pHRI has largely focused on robotic manipulators, employing impedance or admittance control to maintain operational safety. Conversely, research in human-quadrotor cooperative load transportation (CLT) is still in its infancy. This letter introduces a novel admittance controller designed for safe and effective human-quadrotor CLT using a quadrotor equipped with an actively-controlled winch. The proposed method accounts for the system's coupled dynamics, allowing the quadrotor and its cable to dynamically adapt to contact forces during CLT tasks, thereby enhancing responsiveness. We experimentally validated the task-adaptive capability of the controller across the entire CLT process, including in-place loading/unloading and load transporting tasks. To this end, we compared the system performances against a conventional approach, using both variable and fixed cable lengths under low- and high-stiffness conditions. Results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the conventional approach in terms of system responsiveness and motion smoothness, leading to improved CLT capabilities.

摘要（中文）：人与机器人的协作在许多机器人应用中至关重要，特别是在需要物理人机交互（pHRI）的场景中。以往关于pHRI的研究主要集中在机械臂上，通过阻抗或导纳控制来保障操作安全性。相比之下，针对人与四旋翼无人机协同载物运输（CLT）的研究仍处于起步阶段。本文提出了一种新型导纳控制器，专为配备主动控制绞盘的四旋翼无人机实现安全高效的人机协同载物运输而设计。该方法考虑了系统的耦合动力学特性，使无人机及其缆绳能够在CLT任务中动态适应接触力，从而提升响应能力。我们通过实验验证了控制器在整个CLT流程（包括定点装卸与载物运输任务）中的任务自适应能力。为此，我们在低刚度与高刚度条件下，分别采用可变缆长与固定缆长的传统方法进行了系统性能对比。结果表明，所提方法在系统响应性和运动平滑性方面优于传统方法，有效提升了协同载物运输的整体性能。

Authors: Shuai Li, Ton T. H. Duong, Damiano Zanotto

HALO: Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion with Learned Latent Dynamics, Poincaré Maps, and Regions of Attraction

简要说明：提出了HALO框架，通过从腿部机器人轨迹数据中学习具有潜在动力学和庞加莱映射的降阶模型，实现对机器人步态稳定性分析和吸引域估计。

TLDR: Introduces HALO, a framework for learning reduced-order models with latent dynamics and Poincaré maps from trajectory data of legged robots, enabling stability analysis and region-of-attraction estimation for robot locomotion.

Abstract: Reduced-order models are powerful for analyzing and controlling high-dimensional dynamical systems. Yet constructing these models for complex hybrid systems such as legged robots remains challenging. Classical approaches rely on hand-designed template models (e.g., LIP, SLIP), which, though insightful, only approximate the underlying dynamics. In contrast, data-driven methods can extract more accurate low-dimensional representations, but it remains unclear when stability and safety properties observed in the latent space meaningfully transfer back to the full-order system. To bridge this gap, we introduce HALO (Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion), a framework for learning latent reduced-order models of periodic hybrid dynamics directly from trajectory data. HALO employs an autoencoder to identify a low-dimensional latent state together with a learned latent Poincaré map that captures step-to-step locomotion dynamics. This enables Lyapunov analysis and the construction of an associated region of attraction in the latent space, both of which can be lifted back to the full-order state space through the decoder. Experiments on a simulated hopping robot and full-body humanoid locomotion demonstrate that HALO yields low-dimensional models that retain meaningful stability structure and predict full-order region-of-attraction boundaries.

摘要（中文）：降阶模型对于分析和控制高维动力系统具有重要作用。然而，针对腿式机器人等复杂混合系统构建此类模型仍具挑战性。传统方法依赖于手工设计的模板模型（例如LIP、SLIP），这些模型虽具启发性，但仅能近似底层动力学特性。相比之下，数据驱动方法能够提取更精确的低维表征，但潜在空间中观察到的稳定性和安全性属性何时能够有意义地映射回全阶系统，目前仍不明确。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了HALO（混合自编码运动）框架，该框架可直接从轨迹数据中学习周期性混合动力学的潜在降阶模型。HALO采用自编码器识别低维潜在状态，并通过学习到的庞加莱映射捕捉步态间的运动动力学。这使得在潜在空间中进行李雅普诺夫分析并构建相应的吸引域成为可能，两者均可通过解码器映射回全阶状态空间。在仿真的跳跃机器人及全身人形机器人运动实验中，HALO产生的低维模型保留了有效的稳定性结构，并能预测全阶吸引域的边界。

Authors: Blake Werner, Sergio A. Esteban, Massimiliano De Sa, Max H. Cohen, Aaron D. Ames

FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL

简要说明：FASTER 通过在扩散策略的去噪过程早期过滤低价值动作候选，降低强化学习的计算成本，在机器人操作任务和预训练的 VLA 模型上展现出性能提升。

TLDR: FASTER reduces computational cost in reinforcement learning by filtering low-value action candidates early in the denoising process of diffusion policies, demonstrating improvements on robotic manipulation tasks and pretrained VLA models.

Abstract: Some of the most performant reinforcement learning algorithms today can be prohibitively expensive as they use test-time scaling methods such as sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the best one. In this work, we propose FASTER, a method for getting the benefits of sampling-based test-time scaling of diffusion-based policies without the computational cost by tracing the performance gain of action samples back to earlier in the denoising process. Our key insight is that we can model the denoising of multiple action candidates and selecting the best one as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where the goal is to progressively filter action candidates before denoising is complete. With this MDP, we can learn a policy and value function in the denoising space that predicts the downstream value of action candidates in the denoising process and filters them while maximizing returns. The result is a method that is lightweight and can be plugged into existing generative RL algorithms. Across challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks in online and batch-online RL, FASTER consistently improves the underlying policies and achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Applied to a pretrained VLA, FASTER achieves the same performance while substantially reducing training and inference compute requirements. Code is available at https://github.com/alexanderswerdlow/faster .

摘要（中文）：摘要：当前一些性能最优的强化学习算法在应用测试阶段扩展方法（例如采样多个动作候选并选择最优者）时，计算成本可能过高而难以实际应用。本研究提出了FASTER方法，它能够在不增加计算开销的前提下，通过将基于采样的扩散策略测试阶段扩展的性能增益回溯至去噪过程早期，实现类似的效果。我们的核心思路是：将多动作候选的去噪与最优选择过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其目标是在去噪完成前逐步筛选动作候选。基于该MDP框架，我们可以在去噪空间中学习策略和价值函数，以预测去噪过程中动作候选的后续价值，并在最大化回报的同时对其进行筛选。由此得到的方法轻量灵活，可集成至现有生成式强化学习算法中。在在线与批量在线强化学习的复杂长程操控任务中，FASTER持续提升了基础策略的性能，并在对比方法中取得了最佳综合表现。将其应用于预训练的视觉语言模型后，FASTER在显著降低训练和推理计算需求的同时，实现了同等性能水平。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/alexanderswerdlow/faster。

Authors: Perry Dong, Alexander Swerdlow, Dorsa Sadigh, Chelsea Finn

If you're waiting for a sign... that might not be it! Mitigating Trust Boundary Confusion from Visual Injections on Vision-Language Agentic Systems

简要说明：该论文研究了视觉语言智能体系统（VLAS）中的信任边界混淆问题，即智能体难以区分合法的环境线索和对抗性视觉注入。它提出了一个多智能体防御框架，以提高在具身环境中对此类误导信号的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper studies trust boundary confusion in Vision-Language Agentic Systems (VLAS), where agents struggle to distinguish between legitimate environmental cues and adversarial visual injections. It proposes a multi-agent defense framework to improve robustness against such misleading signals in embodied settings.

Abstract: Recent advances in embodied Vision-Language Agentic Systems (VLAS), powered by large vision-language models (LVLMs), enable AI systems to perceive and reason over real-world scenes. Within this context, environmental signals such as traffic lights are essential in-band signals that can and should influence agent behavior. However, similar signals could also be crafted to operate as misleading visual injections, overriding user intent and posing security risks. This duality creates a fundamental challenge: agents must respond to legitimate environmental cues while remaining robust to misleading ones. We refer to this tension as trust boundary confusion. To study this behavior, we design a dual-intent dataset and evaluation framework, through which we show that current LVLM-based agents fail to reliably balance this trade-off, either ignoring useful signals or following harmful ones. We systematically evaluate 7 LVLM agents across multiple embodied settings under both structure-based and noise-based visual injections. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose a multi-agent defense framework that separates perception from decision-making to dynamically assess the reliability of visual inputs. Our approach significantly reduces misleading behaviors while preserving correct responses and provides robustness guarantees under adversarial perturbations. The code of the evaluation framework and artifacts are made available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Visual-Prompt-Inject.

摘要（中文）：近年来，基于大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的具身视觉语言智能体系统（VLAS）取得了重要进展，使人工智能系统能够感知并推理现实世界场景。在此背景下，交通灯等环境信号是重要的带内信号，能够且应当影响智能体的行为。然而，此类信号也可能被刻意设计成误导性视觉注入，从而违背用户意图并引发安全风险。这种双重性带来了根本性挑战：智能体既要响应合法的环境提示，又需对误导性信号保持鲁棒性。我们将这种矛盾关系称为信任边界混淆。为研究该现象，我们构建了双重意图数据集与评估框架，并以此证明当前基于LVLM的智能体无法可靠平衡这一权衡——它们要么忽略有用信号，要么遵循有害指令。我们在结构化与噪声型视觉注入两种模式下，系统性地评估了7种LVLM智能体在多个具身场景中的表现。针对这些漏洞，我们提出了一种多智能体防御框架，通过分离感知与决策过程来动态评估视觉输入的可靠性。该方法在保持正确响应的同时显著减少了误导性行为，并为对抗性扰动提供了鲁棒性保障。评估框架代码及相关资源已发布于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Visual-Prompt-Inject。

Authors: Jiamin Chang, Minhui Xue, Ruoxi Sun, Shuchao Pang, Salil S. Kanhere, Hammond Pearce

Environmental Understanding Vision-Language Model for Embodied Agent

简要说明：本文提出了一种框架（EUEA），通过微调视觉语言模型来增强具身智能体对环境的理解和任务执行能力，在ALFRED任务上展示了显著的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework (EUEA) for fine-tuning VLMs to improve environmental understanding and task execution for embodied instruction-following agents, demonstrating significant performance gains on ALFRED tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong perception and reasoning abilities for instruction-following embodied agents. However, despite these abilities and their generalization performance, they still face limitations in environmental understanding, often failing on interactions or relying on environment metadata during execution. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework named Environmental Understanding Embodied Agent (EUEA), which fine-tunes four core skills: 1) object perception for identifying relevant objects, 2) task planning for generating interaction subgoals, 3) action understanding for judging success likelihood, and 4) goal recognition for determining goal completion. By fine-tuning VLMs with EUEA skills, our framework enables more reliable task execution for instruction-following. We further introduce a recovery step that leverages these core skills and a group relative policy optimization (GRPO) stage that refines inconsistent skill predictions. The recovery step samples alternative actions to correct failure cases, and the GRPO stage refines inconsistent skill predictions. Across ALFRED tasks, our VLM significantly outperforms a behavior-cloning baseline, achieving an 8.86% improvement in average success rate. The recovery and GRPO stages provide an additional 3.03% gain, further enhancing overall performance. Finally, our skill-level analyses reveal key limitations in the environmental understanding of closed- and open-source VLMs and identify the capabilities necessary for effective agent-environment interaction.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLM）在遵循指令的具身智能体方面展现出强大的感知与推理能力。然而，尽管具备这些能力及泛化性能，此类模型在环境理解方面仍存在局限，常在执行过程中因交互失败或依赖环境元数据而导致任务受阻。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种名为环境理解具身智能体的新型框架，该框架通过微调四项核心技能：1）用于识别相关物体的对象感知，2）用于生成交互子目标的任务规划，3）用于判断成功可能性的动作理解，以及4）用于确定目标完成度的目标识别。通过基于EUEA技能对VLM进行微调，我们的框架能够为指令跟随型智能体实现更可靠的任务执行。我们进一步引入了利用这些核心技能的恢复步骤，以及优化不一致技能预测的群组相对策略优化阶段：恢复步骤通过采样替代动作以修正失败案例，而GRPO阶段则对不一致的技能预测进行精炼。在ALFRED任务集中，我们的VLM显著优于行为克隆基线，平均成功率提升8.86%。恢复步骤与GRPO阶段带来额外3.03%的性能增益，进一步提升了整体表现。最后，我们的技能层级分析揭示了闭源与开源VLM在环境理解方面的关键局限，并明确了实现高效智能体-环境交互所必需的核心能力。

Authors: Jinsik Bang, Jaeyeon Bae, Donggyu Lee, Siyeol Jung, Taehwan Kim

HELM: Harness-Enhanced Long-horizon Memory for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation

简要说明：本文提出HELM框架，通过引入情景记忆、学习的状态验证器和用于回滚与重规划的约束控制器，解决VLA模型在长程机器人操作任务中失败的问题。

TLDR: The paper proposes HELM, a framework to address long-horizon manipulation failures in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by introducing episodic memory, a learned state verifier, and a harness controller for rollback and replanning.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fail systematically on long-horizon manipulation tasks despite strong short-horizon performance. We show that this failure is not resolved by extending context length alone in the current reactive execution setting; instead, it stems from three recurring execution-loop deficiencies: the memory gap, the verification gap, and the recovery gap. We present HELM, a model-agnostic framework that addresses these deficiencies with three components: an Episodic Memory Module (EMM) that retrieves key task history via CLIP-indexed keyframes, a learned State Verifier (SV) that predicts action failure before execution from observation, action, subgoal, and memory-conditioned context, and a Harness Controller (HC) that performs rollback and replanning. The SV is the core learning contribution: it consistently outperforms rule-based feasibility checks and ensemble uncertainty baselines, and its effectiveness depends critically on access to episodic memory. On LIBERO-LONG, HELM improves task success rate by 23.1 percentage points over OpenVLA (58.4% to 81.5%), while extending the context window to H=32 yields only a 5.4-point gain and same-budget LoRA adaptation remains 12.2 points below HELM. HELM also improves long-horizon performance on CALVIN and substantially boosts recovery success under controlled perturbations. Ablations and mechanism analyses isolate the contribution of each component, and we release LIBERO-Recovery as a perturbation-injection protocol for evaluating failure recovery in long-horizon manipulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在长时程操作任务上存在系统性失败，尽管其在短时程任务中表现优异。研究表明，仅靠扩展当前反应式执行环境中的上下文长度无法解决这一问题；其根本原因在于执行循环中存在的三个固有缺陷：记忆间隙、验证间隙与恢复间隙。本文提出HELM框架——一个与模型无关的解决方案，通过三个核心组件应对这些缺陷：基于CLIP索引关键帧提取关键任务历史的片段记忆模块、从观测数据、动作、子目标及记忆条件化上下文中预测执行前动作失败的学理状态验证器，以及执行回滚与重规划的协调控制器。状态验证器是本文的核心学习贡献：其表现始终优于基于规则的可行性检查与集成不确定性基线方法，且其有效性高度依赖于对片段记忆的访问。在LIBERO-LONG测试中，HELM将任务成功率较OpenVLA提升23.1个百分点（从58.4%至81.5%），而仅将上下文窗口扩展至H=32仅带来5.4个百分点的提升，同等预算的LoRA自适应方法仍落后HELM12.2个百分点。HELM在CALVIN数据集的长时程任务中也显著提升性能，并在受控扰动下大幅提高恢复成功率。消融实验与机理分析揭示了各组件独立贡献，同时我们发布LIBERO-Recovery作为扰动注入协议，用于评估长时程操作中的失败恢复能力。

Authors: Zijian Zeng, Fei Ding, Huiming Yang, Xianwei Li

Explore Like Humans: Autonomous Exploration with Online SG-Memo Construction for Embodied Agents

简要说明：本文提出ABot-Explorer，一种在线探索框架，利用视觉-语言模型在导航过程中构建语义空间记忆，模拟类人探索行为，用于具身智能体。

TLDR: This paper introduces ABot-Explorer, an online exploration framework that uses Vision-Language Models to build a semantic spatial memory during navigation, mirroring human-like exploration for embodied agents.

Abstract: Constructing structured spatial memory is essential for enabling long-horizon reasoning in complex embodied navigation tasks. Current memory construction predominantly relies on a decoupled, two-stage paradigm: agents first aggregate environmental data through exploration, followed by the offline reconstruction of spatial memory. However, this post-hoc and geometry-centric approach precludes agents from leveraging high-level semantic intelligence, often causing them to overlook navigationally critical landmarks (e.g., doorways and staircases) that serve as fundamental semantic anchors in human cognitive maps. To bridge this gap, we propose ABot-Explorer, a novel active exploration framework that unifies memory construction and exploration into an online, RGB-only process. At its core, ABot-Explorer leverages Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to distill Semantic Navigational Affordances (SNA), which act as cognitive-aligned anchors to guide the agent's movement. By dynamically integrating these SNAs into a hierarchical SG-Memo, ABot-Explorer mirrors human-like exploratory logic by prioritizing structural transit nodes to facilitate efficient coverage. To support this framework, we contribute a large-scale dataset extending InteriorGS with SNA and SG-Memo annotations. Experimental results demonstrate that ABot-Explorer significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in both exploration efficiency and environment coverage, while the resulting SG-Memo is shown to effectively support diverse downstream tasks.

摘要（中文）：构建结构化空间记忆对于实现复杂具身导航任务中的长程推理至关重要。当前记忆构建主要依赖于解耦的两阶段范式：智能体首先通过探索聚合环境数据，随后离线重构空间记忆。然而，这种后验且以几何为中心的方法使智能体无法利用高层语义智能，常导致其忽略对人类认知地图中作为基础语义锚点的导航关键地标（如门廊与楼梯）。为弥补这一差距，我们提出ABot-Explorer——一种将记忆构建与探索统一为在线、纯RGB过程的新型主动探索框架。该框架核心在于利用大型视觉语言模型提取语义导航可供性，这些可供性作为认知对齐的锚点来引导智能体移动。通过动态整合这些语义导航可供性至分层SG-Memo，ABot-Explorer通过优先处理结构化通行节点以提升探索效率，从而模拟类人探索逻辑。为支持此框架，我们构建了基于InteriorGS扩展的大规模数据集，并标注了语义导航可供性与SG-Memo。实验结果表明，ABot-Explorer在探索效率和环境覆盖率上均显著优于当前最先进方法，同时生成的SG-Memo被证明能有效支持多样化的下游任务。

Authors: Xu Chen, Shichao Xie, Zhining Gu, Lu Jia, Minghua Luo, Fei Liu, Zedong Chu, Yanfen Shen, Xiaolong Wu, Mu Xu

Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning in Non-stationary Environments

简要说明：本文针对非平稳环境提出安全持续强化学习，引入基准测试并评估平衡安全约束与适应能力的方法，直接适用于机器人长期控制。

TLDR: This paper introduces safe continual reinforcement learning for non-stationary environments, proposing benchmarks and evaluating methods that balance safety constraints with adaptation, which is directly applicable to long-term robot control.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a compelling data-driven paradigm for synthesizing controllers for complex systems when accurate physical models are unavailable; however, most existing control-oriented RL methods assume stationarity and, therefore, struggle in real-world non-stationary deployments where system dynamics and operating conditions can change unexpectedly. Moreover, RL controllers acting in physical environments must satisfy safety constraints throughout their learning and execution phases, rendering transient violations during adaptation unacceptable. Although continual RL and safe RL have each addressed non-stationarity and safety, respectively, their intersection remains comparatively unexplored, motivating the study of safe continual RL algorithms that can adapt over the system's lifetime while preserving safety. In this work, we systematically investigate safe continual reinforcement learning by introducing three benchmark environments that capture safety-critical continual adaptation and by evaluating representative approaches from safe RL, continual RL, and their combinations. Our empirical results reveal a fundamental tension between maintaining safety constraints and preventing catastrophic forgetting under non-stationary dynamics, with existing methods generally failing to achieve both objectives simultaneously. To address this shortcoming, we examine regularization-based strategies that partially mitigate this trade-off and characterize their benefits and limitations. Finally, we outline key open challenges and research directions toward developing safe, resilient learning-based controllers capable of sustained autonomous operation in changing environments.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）在无法获取精确物理模型时，为复杂系统提供了一种极具吸引力的数据驱动控制策略设计范式；然而，现有大多数面向控制的RL方法基于系统平稳性假设，在实际非平稳部署场景中，当系统动态特性和运行条件意外变化时，这些方法往往难以有效应对。此外，在物理环境中运行的RL控制器必须在学习与执行阶段全程满足安全约束，这意味着在适应过程中出现任何瞬态约束违反都是不可接受的。尽管持续强化学习和安全强化学习分别针对非平稳性与安全性问题展开了研究，但二者交叉领域仍相对缺乏探索，这促使我们研究能够适应系统全生命周期变化并保持安全性的安全持续强化学习算法。本研究通过构建三个体现安全关键型持续适应需求的基准测试环境，并系统评估来自安全RL、持续RL及其组合的代表性方法，对安全持续强化学习进行了系统探究。实验结果表明，在非平稳动态环境下，维持安全约束与防止灾难性遗忘之间存在根本性矛盾，而现有方法通常无法同时实现这两个目标。为弥补这一缺陷，我们探讨了基于正则化的策略，这些策略能部分缓解上述权衡关系，本文详细分析了其优势与局限。最后，我们提出了关键性开放挑战与研究方向，以推动开发能够适应环境变化、实现持续自主运行的安全且鲁棒的学习型控制器。

Authors: Austin Coursey, Abel Diaz-Gonzalez, Marcos Quinones-Grueiro, Gautam Biswas

A Gesture-Based Visual Learning Model for Acoustophoretic Interactions using a Swarm of AcoustoBots

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于手势的视觉学习框架，用于与多模态机器人平台进行人机交互，利用视觉语言模型分类手势并将其映射到机器人控制命令。

TLDR: This paper presents a gesture-based visual learning framework for human-swarm interaction with a multimodal robot platform, using a VLM to classify gestures and map them to robotic control commands.

Abstract: AcoustoBots are mobile acoustophoretic robots capable of delivering mid-air haptics, directional audio, and acoustic levitation, but existing implementations rely on scripted commands and lack an intuitive interface for real-time human control. This work presents a gesture-based visual learning framework for contactless human-swarm interaction with a multimodal AcoustoBot platform. The system combines ESP32-CAM gesture capture, PhaseSpace motion tracking, centralized processing, and an OpenCLIP-based visual learning model (VLM) with linear probing to classify three hand gestures and map them to haptics, audio, and levitation modalities. Validation accuracy improved from about 67% with a small dataset to nearly 98% with the largest dataset. In integrated experiments with two AcoustoBots, the system achieved an overall gesture-to-modality switching accuracy of 87.8% across 90 trials, with an average end-to-end latency of 3.95 seconds. These results demonstrate the feasibility of using a vision-language-model-based gesture interface for multimodal human-swarm interaction. While the current system is limited by centralized processing, a static gesture set, and controlled-environment evaluation, it establishes a foundation for more expressive, scalable, and accessible swarm robotic interfaces.

摘要（中文）：声波机器人是一种移动式声泳机器人，能够实现空中触觉反馈、定向音频和声悬浮功能，但现有实现方式依赖于脚本命令，缺乏用于实时人工控制的直观界面。本研究提出了一种基于手势的视觉学习框架，用于实现与多模态声波机器人平台的非接触式人机集群交互。该系统结合了ESP32-CAM手势捕捉、PhaseSpace运动追踪、中央化处理，以及基于OpenCLIP的视觉学习模型（VLM）和线性探针技术，实现了三种手势的分类并将其映射到触觉、音频和悬浮模态。验证准确率从使用小数据集时的约67%提升至使用最大数据集时的近98%。在两个声波机器人的集成实验中，该系统在90次试验中整体手势到模态切换准确率达到87.8%，平均端到端延迟为3.95秒。这些结果证明了基于视觉语言模型的手势界面用于多模态人机集群交互的可行性。尽管当前系统受限于中央化处理、静态手势集和受控环境评估，但它为开发更具表现力、可扩展性和易用性的集群机器人交互界面奠定了基础。

Authors: Alex Lin, Lei Gao, Narsimlu Kemsaram, Sriram Subramanian

Autonomous UAV Pipeline Near-proximity Inspection via Disturbance-Aware Predictive Visual Servoing

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于四旋翼无人机自主近距离巡检管道的抗扰动视觉伺服控制框架，并在仿真和真实世界实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a disturbance-aware visual servoing control framework for autonomous quadrotor UAVs to perform near-proximity inspection of pipelines, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Reliable pipeline inspection is critical to safe energy transportation, but is constrained by long distances, complex terrain, and risks to human inspectors. Unmanned aerial vehicles provide a flexible sensing platform, yet reliable autonomous inspection remains challenging. This paper presents an autonomous quadrotor near-proximity pipeline inspection framework for three-dimensional scenarios based on image-based visual servoing model predictive control (VMPC). A unified predictive model couples quadrotor dynamics with image feature kinematics, enabling direct image-space prediction within the control loop. To address low-rate visual updates, measurement noise, and environmental uncertainties, an extended-state Kalman filtering scheme with image feature prediction (ESKF-PRE) is developed, and the estimated lumped disturbances are incorporated into the VMPC prediction model, yielding the ESKF-PRE-VMPC framework. A terrain-adaptive velocity design is introduced to maintain the desired cruising speed while generating vertical velocity references over unknown terrain slopes without prior terrain information. The framework is validated in high-fidelity Gazebo simulations and real-world experiments. In real-world tests, the proposed method reduces RMSE by 52.63% and 75.04% in pipeline orientation and lateral deviation in the image, respectively, for straight-pipeline inspection without wind, and successfully completes both wind-disturbance and bend-pipeline tasks where baseline method fails. An open-source nano quadrotor is modified for indoor experimentation.

摘要（中文）：可靠的管道巡检对能源安全输送至关重要，但受限于距离长、地形复杂及人工巡检风险等因素。无人机为管道检测提供了灵活的传感平台，但可靠的自主巡检仍面临挑战。本文提出了一种基于图像视觉伺服模型预测控制（VMPC）的三维场景下四旋翼无人机近距管道自主巡检框架。该框架通过统一预测模型耦合四旋翼动力学与图像特征运动学，实现了控制回路内的直接图像空间预测。针对视觉更新率低、测量噪声及环境不确定性问题，本文开发了结合图像特征预测的扩展状态卡尔曼滤波方案（ESKF-PRE），并将估计的集总扰动纳入VMPC预测模型，形成ESKF-PRE-VMPC框架。同时提出地形自适应速度设计方法，在未知地形坡度且无需先验地形信息的情况下，既能维持期望巡航速度，又可生成垂直速度指令。该框架在高保真Gazebo仿真和实际实验中均得到验证。真实场景测试表明：在无风直线管道巡检中，所提方法使管道图像方向与横向偏差的均方根误差分别降低52.63%和75.04%；在基线方法失效的风扰动和弯道管道任务中均能成功完成巡检。实验采用开源纳米四旋翼平台进行室内环境改装验证。

Authors: Wen Li, Hui Wang, Jinya Su, Cunjia Liu, Wen-Hua Chen, Shihua Li

Forward Dynamics of Variable Topology Mechanisms - The Case of Constraint Activation

简要说明：本文提出了一种方法，用于模拟和建模因关节锁定等原因导致运动拓扑发生变化的机械系统的正向动力学，重点是切换事件时的过渡条件。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for modeling and simulating the forward dynamics of mechanical systems whose kinematic topology changes, such as due to joint locking, with a focus on the transition conditions at switching events.

Abstract: Many mechanical systems exhibit changes in their kinematic topology altering the mobility. Ideal contact is the best known cause, but also stiction and controlled locking of parts of a mechanism lead to topology changes. The latter is becoming an important issue in human-machine interaction. Anticipating the dynamic behavior of variable topology mechanisms requires solving a non-smooth dynamic problem. The core challenge is a physically meaningful transition condition at the topology switching events. Such a condition is presented in this paper. Two versions are reported, one using projected motion equations in terms of redundant coordinates, and another one using the Voronets equations in terms of minimal coordinates. Their computational properties are discussed. Results are shown for joint locking of a planar 3R mechanisms and a 6DOF industrial manipulator.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 许多机械系统在运动拓扑结构上会发生变化，从而改变其运动自由度。理想接触是众所周知的原因，但粘滑现象以及机构部件的受控锁定也会导致拓扑结构变化。后者在人机交互中正成为一个重要问题。预测可变拓扑结构机构的动态行为需要解决非光滑动力学问题。其核心挑战在于拓扑切换事件发生时需要满足具有物理意义的过渡条件。本文提出了一种这样的条件。文中介绍了两种版本：一种使用冗余坐标下的投影运动方程，另一种使用最小坐标下的沃罗内茨方程。同时讨论了它们的计算特性。并以平面3R机构和六自由度工业机械臂的关节锁定为例展示了相关结果。

Authors: Andreas Mueller

Achieving Interaction Fluidity in a Wizard-of-Oz Robotic System: A Prototype for Fluid Error-Correction

简要说明：本文提出了流畅的Wizard-of-Oz机器人系统的关键标准，并展示了一个用于移动机械臂的VR HRI仿真环境，以支持语音交互中的流畅纠错。

TLDR: This paper proposes key criteria for fluid Wizard-of-Oz robotic systems and presents a VR HRI simulation environment for mobile manipulators to support fluid error correction in speech-based interaction.

Abstract: Achieving truly fluid interaction with robots with speech interfaces remains a hard problem, and the experience of current Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) remains laboured and frustrating. Some of the barriers to fluid interaction stem from a lack of a suitable development platform for HRI for improving interaction, even in robotic Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) modes of operation used for data collection and prototyping. Based on previous systems, we propose the properties of interruptibility and correction (IaC), pollability, latency measurement and optimisation and time-accurate reproducibility of actions from logging data as key criteria for a fluid WoZ system to support fluid error correction. We finish by presenting a Virtual Reality (VR) HRI simulation environment for mobile manipulators which meets these criteria.

摘要（中文）：实现与语音界面机器人真正流畅的交互仍是一个难题，当前人机交互的体验依然笨拙且令人沮丧。流畅交互的部分障碍源于缺乏合适的人机交互开发平台来改进交互，即使在用于数据收集和原型设计的机器人“绿野仙踪”操作模式下亦是如此。基于现有系统，我们提出可中断性与可修正性、轮询能力、延迟测量与优化，以及从日志数据中实现动作的时间精准重现性等特性，作为支撑流畅错误修正的“绿野仙踪”系统的关键标准。最后，我们展示了一个满足这些标准的、面向移动操作机器人的虚拟现实人机交互仿真环境。

Authors: Carlos Baptista De Lima, Julian Hough, Frank Förster, Patrick Holthaus, Yongjun Zheng

Reinforcement Learning Enabled Adaptive Multi-Task Control for Bipedal Soccer Robots

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于双足足球机器人的模块化强化学习框架，结合开环振荡器和RL反馈以及状态机，管理寻球/踢球和摔倒恢复等任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes a modular reinforcement learning framework for bipedal soccer robots, combining an open-loop oscillator with RL feedback and a state machine to manage tasks like ball seeking/kicking and fall recovery.

Abstract: Developing bipedal football robots in dynamiccombat environments presents challenges related to motionstability and deep coupling of multiple tasks, as well ascontrol switching issues between different states such as up-right walking and fall recovery. To address these problems,this paper proposes a modular reinforcement learning (RL)framework for achieving adaptive multi-task control. Firstly,this framework combines an open-loop feedforward oscilla-tor with a reinforcement learning-based feedback residualstrategy, effectively separating the generation of basic gaitsfrom complex football actions. Secondly, a posture-driven statemachine is introduced, clearly switching between the ballseeking and kicking network (BSKN) and the fall recoverynetwork (FRN), fundamentally preventing state interference.The FRN is efficiently trained through a progressive forceattenuation curriculum learning strategy. The architecture wasverified in Unity simulations of bipedal robots, demonstratingexcellent spatial adaptability-reliably finding and kicking theball even in restricted corner scenarios-and rapid autonomousfall recovery (with an average recovery time of 0.715 seconds).This ensures seamless and stable operation in complex multi-task environments.

摘要（中文）：在动态对抗环境中开发双足足球机器人面临运动稳定性与多任务深度耦合的挑战，以及直立行走与跌倒恢复等不同状态间的控制切换问题。本文提出一种模块化强化学习框架，以实现自适应多任务控制。首先，该框架将开环前馈振荡器与基于强化学习的反馈残差策略相结合，有效分离了基础步态生成与复杂足球动作。其次，引入姿态驱动的状态机，在寻球踢球网络与跌倒恢复网络间实现清晰切换，从根本上防止状态干扰。跌倒恢复网络通过渐进式力衰减课程学习策略进行高效训练。该架构在双足机器人Unity仿真中验证，展现出卓越的空间适应性——即使在受限角落场景中也能可靠寻球踢球，并实现快速自主跌倒恢复（平均恢复时间0.715秒），从而确保复杂多任务环境下的无缝稳定运行。

Authors: Yulai Zhang, Yinrong Zhang, Ting Wu, Linqi Ye

Accelerating trajectory optimization with Sobolev-trained diffusion policies

简要说明：本文提出使用 Sobolev 训练的扩散策略为机器人中的梯度轨迹优化求解器提供热启动初始猜测，利用来自反馈增益的一阶信息来减少求解时间并避免累积误差。

TLDR: This paper proposes using Sobolev-trained diffusion policies to provide warm-start initial guesses for gradient-based trajectory optimization solvers in robotics, leveraging first-order information from feedback gains to reduce solving time and avoid compounding errors.

Abstract: Trajectory Optimization (TO) solvers exploit known system dynamics to compute locally optimal trajectories through iterative improvements. A downside is that each new problem instance is solved independently; therefore, convergence speed and quality of the solution found depend on the initial trajectory proposed. To improve efficiency, a natural approach is to warm-start TO with initial guesses produced by a learned policy trained on trajectories previously generated by the solver. Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as expressive imitation learning models, making them promising candidates for this role. Yet, a counterintuitive challenge comes from the local optimality of TO demonstrations: when a policy is rolled out, small non-optimal deviations may push it into situations not represented in the training data, triggering compounding errors over long horizons. In this work, we focus on learning-based warm-starting for gradient-based TO solvers that also provide feedback gains. Exploiting this specificity, we derive a first-order loss for Sobolev learning of diffusion-based policies using both trajectories and feedback gains. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that the resulting policy avoids compounding errors, and so can learn from very few trajectories to provide initial guesses reducing solving time by $2\times$ to $20 \times$. Incorporating first-order information enables predictions with fewer diffusion steps, reducing inference latency.

摘要（中文）：轨迹优化（TO）求解器通过迭代改进，利用已知的系统动力学计算局部最优轨迹。其缺点在于每个新问题实例都是独立求解的，因此收敛速度与所得解的质量高度依赖于初始提出的轨迹。为提高效率，一种自然的思路是利用已训练的学习策略来生成初始猜测，实现TO的热启动，该策略基于求解器先前生成的轨迹进行训练。基于扩散的策略最近已成为表达能力强的模仿学习模型，使其有望在此任务中发挥作用。然而，一个反直觉的挑战来自TO演示的局部最优性：当策略执行时，微小的非最优偏差可能使其进入训练数据中未包含的工况，从而在长时域中引发累积误差。本研究聚焦于针对基于梯度的TO求解器开发基于学习的热启动方法，这些求解器能够同时提供反馈增益。利用这一特性，我们推导出基于扩散策略的Sobolev一阶损失函数，该函数同时利用轨迹和反馈增益进行学习。通过全面的实验验证，所得策略能够有效避免累积误差，即使仅使用少量轨迹进行训练，也能提供初始猜测，将求解时间缩短至$2\times$到$20\times$不等。引入一阶信息使得预测所需的扩散步数减少，从而降低了推理延迟。
