Authors: Théotime Le Hellard, Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack, Quentin Le Lidec, Justin Carpentier

Multi-modal Reasoning with LLMs for Visual Semantic Arithmetic

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对大型视觉语言模型的强化微调方法，旨在提升其视觉语义算术能力（例如从图像中进行关系推理），并应用于在家庭机器人中实现符号推理的感知基础。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reinforcement fine-tuning method for large vision-language models to improve their ability to perform visual semantic arithmetic (e.g., relational reasoning from images), with applications for grounding symbolic reasoning in domestic robotics.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) as post-training is crucial for enhancing the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) in coding and math. However, their capacity for visual semantic arithmetic, inferring relationships from images, remains underexplored. The classic text analogy "king"-"man"+"woman" = "queen" illustrates relational reasoning, yet replacing text with images of "king" and "man" significantly reduces performance because it requires commonsense knowledge and the extraction of concise concepts from irrelevant visual details. This capability is important for service and domestic robotics in unstructured environments, where robots must infer semantic relationships among objects, agents, and actions. In a kitchen, recognizing from images that "powder" and "cake" are related by "is made of" grounds symbolic relations in perception, enabling tool substitution, task generalization, and improved semantic reasoning. Prior work approaches semantic arithmetic by decoding image features after vector arithmetic, but suffers from modality gaps and lacks systematic evaluation. In this paper, we formulate two novel tasks, two-term subtraction and three-term operations, and construct the Image-Relation-Pair Dataset (IRPD) for benchmarking. We further propose Semantic Arithmetic Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (SAri-RFT), which post-trains large vision-language models (LVLMs) using a verifiable function and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on IRPD and the real-world Visual7W-Telling dataset. By equipping LVLMs with robust cross-modal relational reasoning, this work advances domestic robots' ability to ground symbolic reasoning in perception, enhancing decision-making, tool adaptability, and human-robot interaction in complex environments. Datasets and source code are provided in the supplementary material.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）作为后训练方法，对于提升大语言模型（LLMs）在编程和数学中的推理能力至关重要。然而，其在视觉语义算术方面的能力——即从图像中推断关系——仍未得到充分探索。经典的文本类比“国王”-“男人”+“女人”=“女王”展示了关系推理，但若将文本替换为“国王”和“男人”的图像，性能会显著下降，因为这需要常识知识以及从无关视觉细节中提取简洁概念。这种能力对于非结构化环境中的服务和家用机器人尤为重要，机器人必须推断物体、智能体与动作之间的语义关系。在厨房中，通过图像识别出“粉末”与“蛋糕”之间“由...制成”的关系，能将符号关系扎根于感知中，从而实现工具替换、任务泛化和语义推理的增强。先前的研究通过向量算术后解码图像特征来实现语义算术，但存在模态鸿沟问题且缺乏系统性评估。本文提出两项新任务：二项减法和三项运算，并构建了用于基准测试的图像-关系对数据集（IRPD）。我们进一步提出语义算术强化微调方法（SAri-RFT），该方法采用可验证函数和组相对策略优化（GRPO）对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）进行后训练。我们的方法在IRPD和真实世界Visual7W-Telling数据集上取得了最先进的结果。通过赋予LVLMs强大的跨模态关系推理能力，这项工作提升了家用机器人在感知中实现符号推理的能力，从而增强复杂环境下的决策制定、工具适应性和人机交互。数据集与源代码详见补充材料。

Authors: Chuou Xu, Liya Ji, Qifeng Chen

Low-Rank Adaptation for Critic Learning in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文将低秩适配（LoRA）用作离策略强化学习中价值函数的正则化器，以防止过拟合并提升训练稳定性。该方法在DeepMind Control运动与IsaacLab机器人基准测试上进行了评估，结果显示其改善了价值函数损失与策略性能。

TLDR: This paper applies Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural regularizer for critics in off-policy reinforcement learning to prevent overfitting and improve stability. It evaluates the method on DeepMind Control locomotion and IsaacLab robotics benchmarks, showing improved critic loss and policy performance.

Abstract: Scaling critic capacity is a promising direction for enhancing off-policy reinforcement learning (RL). However, larger critics are prone to overfitting and unstable in replay-buffer-based bootstrap training. This paper leverages Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural-sparsity regularizer for off-policy critics. Our approach freezes randomly initialized base matrices and solely optimizes low-rank adapters, thereby constraining critic updates to a low-dimensional subspace. Built on top of SimbaV2, we further develop a LoRA formulation, compatible with SimbaV2, that preserves its hyperspherical normalization geometry under frozen-backbone training. We evaluate our method with SAC and FastTD3 on DeepMind Control locomotion and IsaacLab robotics benchmarks. LoRA consistently achieves lower critic loss during training and stronger policy performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that adaptive low-rank updates provide a simple, scalable, and effective structural regularization for critic learning in off-policy RL.

摘要（中文）：扩大评论家网络规模是提升离线策略强化学习性能的一个有前景的方向。然而，在基于经验回放池的自举式训练中，较大的评论家网络容易过拟合且训练不稳定。本文利用低秩适配作为离线策略评论家网络的结构稀疏正则化器。该方法冻结随机初始化的基础矩阵，仅优化低秩适配器，从而将评论家网络更新约束在低维子空间内。我们在SimbaV2框架基础上进一步开发了兼容的低秩适配方案，该方案在骨干网络冻结训练时能够保持其超球面归一化几何特性。通过SAC和FastTD3算法在DeepMind Control运动控制与IsaacLab机器人基准测试中进行评估，低秩适配方法在训练过程中始终获得更低的评论家损失和更强的策略性能。大量实验表明，自适应低秩更新为离线策略强化学习中的评论家训练提供了一种简单、可扩展且高效的结构正则化方法。

Authors: Yuan Zhuang, Yuexin Bian, Sihong He, Jie Feng, Qing Su, Songyang Han, Jonathan Petit, Shihao Ji, Yuanyuan Shi, Fei Miao

The Essence of Balance for Self-Improving Agents in Vision-and-Language Navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种名为稳定性-多样性平衡（SDB）的方法，通过平衡行为多样性和学习稳定性来改进视觉语言导航（VLN）中智能体的自我提升能力，在标准基准测试中取得了显著性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method called Stability-Diversity Balance (SDB) to improve the self-improvement of agents in Vision-and-Language Navigation by balancing behavioral diversity with learning stability, achieving significant performance gains on standard benchmarks.

Abstract: In vision-and-language navigation (VLN), self-improvement from policy-induced experience, using only standard VLN action supervision, critically depends on balancing behavioral diversity and learning stability, which governs whether the agent can extract a reliable learning signal for improvement. Increasing behavioral diversity is necessary to expose alternative action hypotheses but can destabilize policy-induced learning signals, whereas overly conservative stability constraints suppress exploration and induce early commitment, making reliable self-improvement difficult. To address this challenge, we propose Stability-Diversity Balance (SDB), a plug-and-play mechanism for balanced self-improvement in VLN. SDB expands each decision step into multiple latent behavioral hypotheses by applying controlled shifts in the instruction-conditioned hidden states, and then performs reliability-aware soft evaluation and aggregation to retain diverse yet instruction-consistent alternatives during learning. An explicit regularizer further constrains hypothesis interactions, preventing excessive drift or premature collapse of hypothesis diversity and stabilizing self-improvement without discarding training signals. Experiments on R2R, SOON, and REVERIE show consistent improvements; for example, on REVERIE val-unseen, SDB improves SPL from 33.73 to 35.93 and OSR from 51.07 to 54.25.

摘要（中文）：在视觉与语言导航（VLN）中，仅依靠标准VLN动作监督从策略诱导经验中实现自我改进，关键在于平衡行为多样性与学习稳定性，这决定了智能体能否提取可靠的学习信号以提升性能。增加行为多样性有助于探索替代动作假设，但可能破坏策略诱导学习信号的稳定性；而过于保守的稳定性约束则会抑制探索、导致过早决策固化，使可靠的自我改进难以实现。针对这一挑战，我们提出稳定性-多样性平衡机制（SDB），这是一种即插即用的VLN平衡自改进方法。SDB通过对指令条件隐藏状态施加受控偏移，将每个决策步骤扩展为多个潜在行为假设，随后执行可靠性感知的软评估与聚合，在学习过程中保留多样且符合指令一致性的备选方案。通过显式正则化进一步约束假设间交互，防止假设多样性过度漂移或过早坍缩，在不丢弃训练信号的前提下稳定自改进过程。在R2R、SOON和REVERIE数据集上的实验表明该方法持续有效提升性能：例如在REVERIE val-unseen数据集上，SDB将SPL从33.73提升至35.93，OSR从51.07提升至54.25。

Authors: Zhen Liu, Yuhan Liu, Jinjun Wang, Jianyi Liu, Wei Song, Jingwen Fu

Multi-Step Gaussian Process Propagation for Adaptive Path Planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于高斯过程的路径规划方法OLAhGP，用于机器人环境探索，该方法结合了环境不确定性和约束条件，并在用于藻类监测的自主水面船只上进行了演示。

TLDR: The paper presents OLAhGP, a Gaussian process-based path planning method for robotic environmental exploration that incorporates environmental uncertainty and constraints. It is demonstrated on an autonomous surface vessel for algal bloom monitoring.

Abstract: Efficient and robust path planning hinges on combining all accessible information sources. In particular, the task of path planning for robotic environmental exploration and monitoring depends highly on the current belief of the world. To capture the uncertainty in the belief, we present a Gaussian process based path planning method that adapts to multi-modal environmental sensing data and incorporates state and input constraints. To solve the path planning problem, we optimize over future waypoints in a receding horizon fashion, and our cost is thus a function of the Gaussian process posterior over all these waypoints. We demonstrate this method, dubbed OLAhGP, on an autonomous surface vessel using oceanic algal bloom data from both a high-fidelity model and in-situ sensing data in a monitoring scenario. Our simulated and experimental results demonstrate significant improvement over existing methods. With the same number of samples, our method generates more informative paths and achieves greater accuracy in identifying algal blooms in chlorophyll a rich waters, measured with respect to total misclassification probability and binary misclassification rate over the domain of interest.

摘要（中文）：高效稳健的路径规划依赖于整合所有可用信息源。特别是在机器人环境探索与监测的路径规划任务中，其效果高度依赖于对环境的当前认知状态。为量化认知中的不确定性，本文提出一种基于高斯过程的路径规划方法，能够适应多模态环境传感数据，并融合状态与输入约束。我们通过滚动时域方式对未来航路点进行优化求解，其成本函数取决于这些航路点对应的高斯过程后验分布。该方法被命名为OLAhGP，我们在自主水面舰艇上使用高保真模型与现场监测场景中的藻华数据进行了验证。模拟与实验结果表明，相较于现有方法，本方法取得了显著提升。在相同采样数量下，本方法能生成信息量更丰富的路径，并在叶绿素a富集水域的藻华识别中实现更高准确度，该优势通过全域总误分类概率与二元误分类率两项指标得到验证。

Authors: Alex Beaudin, Bjørn Andreas Kristiansen, Kristoffer Gryte, Corrado Chiatante, Morten Omholt Alver, Murat Arcak, Tor Arne Johansen

Thrust Regulation Through Wing Linkage Modulation on the Aerobat Platform: Piezoelectric Slip-Stick Actuated Regulator Development

简要说明：本文提出一种通过调节连杆有效长度，利用压电滑粘致动器来实现仿蝙蝠扑翼机器人独立翼推力控制的机制。

TLDR: This paper presents a thrust regulation mechanism for a bat-inspired flapping-wing robot by modulating the effective length of a linkage, using a piezoelectric slip-stick actuator to enable independent wing control.

Abstract: Aerobat is a bat-inspired flapping-wing robot with a wing gait generate by the computational structure, a planar linkage of carbon fiber links driven by a single motor. This design minimizes weight but couples both wings to a shared input motor, eliminating independent thrust control and preventing asymmetric maneuvers. This thesis investigates thrust regulation by modifying the effective length of the first radius link $R_1$ in the computational structure. Static experiments using FDM-printed $R_1$ links at three lengths (28.58, 29.33, and 30.08 mm) across 3,4, and 5 Hz flapping frequencies demonstrated that a 1.5 mm length increase produced a 37% increase in peak lift force and shifted peak force timing within the downstroke. An additional experiment using a string-actuated regulator mechanism was performed. Further actuation methods were evaluated: sub-gram micro-servo and piezoelectric slip-stick. After both the string-tension and micro-servo actuation methods failed due to structural member compliance and motor fragility respectively, a TULA-50 piezoelectric slip-stick actuator was selected. Multiple force-amplifying mechanisms were prototyped, resulting in a direct-drive variable-length mechanism. This final mechanism was demonstrated in a preliminary bench-top test, though insufficient force output prevented dynamic testing during flapping. This work establishes linkage-length modulation via embedded slip-stick actuation as a viable approach to independent wing thrust control.

摘要（中文）：Aerobat是一款受蝙蝠启发的扑翼机器人，其翼态由计算结构生成——该结构为由单电机驱动的碳纤维连杆构成的平面连杆机构。此设计在实现轻量化的同时，将双翼耦合至同一输入电机，导致无法独立控制推力且难以实现非对称机动。本研究通过调整计算结构中第一半径连杆$R_1$的有效长度来实现推力调节。采用熔融沉积成型技术制作三种长度（28.58、29.33及30.08毫米）的$R_1$连杆进行静态实验，在3、4、5赫兹扑动频率下验证：连杆增长1.5毫米可使峰值升力提升37%，并改变下扑阶段峰值力的出现时机。进一步设计了绳索驱动调节机构进行实验，同时评估了两种驱动方案：亚克量级微型伺服电机与压电粘滑驱动器。因结构件柔顺性及电机脆弱性，绳索张力驱动与微型伺服方案先后失效，最终选用TULA-50压电粘滑驱动器。通过原型测试多种力放大机构，研制出直驱式可变长度机构。该终版机构在初步台架测试中表现良好，但因输出力不足未能实现扑动过程中的动态测试。本研究表明：通过嵌入式粘滑驱动实现连杆长度调制，可作为实现独立翼推力控制的有效途径。

Authors: Luca Ciampaglia

Safety-Critical Contextual Control via Online Riemannian Optimization with World Models

简要说明：该论文提出了一种基于样本的控制框架，利用世界模型和在线黎曼优化来确保上下文控制任务中的安全约束，并在动态导航任务中进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes a sample-based control framework using online Riemannian optimization with world models to enforce safety constraints in contextual control tasks, demonstrated on a dynamic navigation problem.

Abstract: Modern world models are becoming too complex to admit explicit dynamical descriptions. We study safety-critical contextual control, where a Planner must optimize a task objective using only feasibility samples from a black-box Simulator, conditioned on a context signal $ξ_t$. We develop a sample-based Penalized Predictive Control (PPC) framework grounded in online Riemannian optimization, in which the Simulator compresses the feasibility manifold into a score-based density $\hat{p}(u \mid ξ_t)$ that endows the action space with a Riemannian geometry guiding the Planner's gradient descent. The barrier curvature $κ(ξ_t)$, the minimum curvature of the conditional log-density $-\ln\hat{p}(\cdot\midξ_t)$, governs both convergence rate and safety margin, replacing the Lipschitz constant of the unknown dynamics. Our main result is a contextual safety bound showing that the distance from the true feasibility manifold is controlled by the score estimation error and a ratio that depends on $κ(ξ_t)$, both of which improve with richer context. Simulations on a dynamic navigation task confirm that contextual PPC substantially outperforms marginal and frozen density models, with the advantage growing after environment shifts.

摘要（中文）：现代世界模型正变得过于复杂，难以通过显式动力学描述进行刻画。本文研究安全关键语境控制问题，其中规划器仅能依据黑箱仿真器提供的可行性样本，在语境信号$ξ_t$条件下优化任务目标。我们基于在线黎曼优化理论，建立了基于样本的惩罚预测控制框架。该框架中，仿真器将可行性流形压缩为基于分数的密度估计$\hat{p}(u \mid ξ_t)$，从而为动作空间赋予黎曼几何结构，以指导规划器的梯度下降过程。屏障曲率$κ(ξ_t)$——即条件对数密度$-\ln\hat{p}(\cdot\midξ_t)$的最小曲率——同时控制着收敛速率与安全边界，替代了未知动力学系统的李普希茨常数。我们的核心成果是语境安全边界定理，证明真实可行性流形的距离由分数估计误差与取决于$κ(ξ_t)$的比值共同控制，二者均随语境信息丰富度提升而改善。动态导航任务的仿真实验表明，语境惩罚预测控制显著优于边际密度与静态密度模型，且在环境发生突变时优势更为凸显。

Authors: Tongxin Li

CityRAG: Stepping Into a City via Spatially-Grounded Video Generation

简要说明：CityRAG是一个视频生成模型，可为自动驾驶和机器人仿真等下游应用，创建真实地点的3D一致、可导航的仿真环境。

TLDR: CityRAG is a video generation model that creates 3D-consistent, navigable simulations of real-world locations for downstream applications like autonomous driving and robotics simulation.

Abstract: We address the problem of generating a 3D-consistent, navigable environment that is spatially grounded: a simulation of a real location. Existing video generative models can produce a plausible sequence that is consistent with a text (T2V) or image (I2V) prompt. However, the capability to reconstruct the real world under arbitrary weather conditions and dynamic object configurations is essential for downstream applications including autonomous driving and robotics simulation. To this end, we present CityRAG, a video generative model that leverages large corpora of geo-registered data as context to ground generation to the physical scene, while maintaining learned priors for complex motion and appearance changes. CityRAG relies on temporally unaligned training data, which teaches the model to semantically disentangle the underlying scene from its transient attributes. Our experiments demonstrate that CityRAG can generate coherent minutes-long, physically grounded video sequences, maintain weather and lighting conditions over thousands of frames, achieve loop closure, and navigate complex trajectories to reconstruct real-world geography.

摘要（中文）：我们致力于解决生成具有空间真实性的三维一致可导航环境问题——即对真实地点的仿真模拟。现有视频生成模型虽能依据文本（T2V）或图像（I2V）提示生成连贯的序列，但要在任意天气条件与动态物体配置下重建真实世界，对于自动驾驶和机器人仿真等下游应用至关重要。为此，我们提出CityRAG模型，该模型利用大规模地理配准数据作为上下文，将生成内容锚定于物理场景，同时保持模型对复杂运动与外观变化的学习先验。CityRAG基于时序非对齐的训练数据，使模型能够从语义上解耦基础场景与瞬时属性。实验表明，CityRAG能生成长达数分钟、物理真实且连贯的视频序列，在数千帧中保持天气与光照条件的一致性，实现场景闭环，并可通过复杂轨迹导航以重建真实地理环境。

Authors: Gene Chou, Charles Herrmann, Kyle Genova, Boyang Deng, Songyou Peng, Bharath Hariharan, Jason Y. Zhang, Noah Snavely, Philipp Henzler

BALTIC: A Benchmark and Cross-Domain Strategy for 3D Reconstruction Across Air and Underwater Domains Under Varying Illumination

简要说明：本文介绍了BALTIC，一个用于评估在不同光照条件下跨空气和水下领域的3D重建方法的基准，重点关注如Gaussian Splatting等方法在这些挑战性环境中的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces BALTIC, a benchmark for evaluating 3D reconstruction methods across air and underwater domains under varying illumination, focusing on the performance of methods like Gaussian Splatting in these challenging conditions.

Abstract: Robust 3D reconstruction across varying environmental conditions remains a critical challenge for robotic perception, particularly when transitioning between air and water. To address this, we introduce BALTIC, a controlled benchmark designed to systematically evaluate modern 3D reconstruction methods under variations in medium and lighting. The benchmark comprises 13 datasets spanning two media (air and water) and three lighting conditions (ambient, artificial, and mixed), with additional variations in motion type, scanning pattern, and initialization trajectory, resulting in a diverse set of sequences. Our experimental setup features a custom water tank equipped with a monocular camera and an HTC Vive tracker, enabling accurate ground-truth pose estimation. We further investigate cross-domain reconstruction by augmenting underwater image sequences with a small number of in-air views captured under similar lighting conditions. We evaluate Structure-from-Motion reconstruction using COLMAP in terms of both trajectory accuracy and scene geometry, and use these reconstructions as input to Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting methods. The resulting models are assessed against ground-truth trajectories and in-air references, while rendered outputs are compared using perceptual and photometric metrics. Additionally, we perform a color restoration analysis to evaluate radiometric consistency across domains. Our results show that under controlled, texture-consistent conditions, Gaussian Splatting with simple preprocessing (e.g., white balance correction) can achieve performance comparable to specialized underwater methods, although its robustness decreases in more complex and heterogeneous real-world environments

摘要（中文）：在不同环境条件下实现鲁棒的3D重建，特别是在空气与水介质间转换时，仍是机器人感知领域面临的关键挑战。为此，我们提出BALTIC，一个旨在系统评估现代3D重建方法在介质与光照变化下性能的标准化基准。该基准包含13个数据集，涵盖两种介质（空气与水）和三种光照条件（环境光、人工光与混合光），并通过运动类型、扫描模式及初始化轨迹的额外变化，形成多样化的序列组合。实验装置采用配备单目相机与HTC Vive追踪器的定制水槽，可实现高精度的真实位姿估计。我们进一步通过在水下图像序列中增补少量在相似光照条件下采集的空中视图，探索跨域重建方法。利用COLMAP进行运动结构重建，从轨迹精度与场景几何两个维度进行评估，并将重建结果作为神经辐射场与3D高斯溅射方法的输入。所得模型通过与真实轨迹和空中参照数据进行对比评估，渲染输出则通过感知指标与光度学指标进行量化比较。此外，我们通过色彩复原分析评估跨域辐射一致性。结果表明，在纹理一致的可控条件下，经过简单预处理（如白平衡校正）的高斯溅射方法可实现与专业水下方法相当的性能，但其在更复杂、异质的真实环境中的鲁棒性有所下降。
